title: Affiliate Marketing Mentor • Performance Marketing Strategist • AI Content & Video Creative Specialist – Part Time
description:
**LOW INITIAL PAYOUT → LEARN → IMPLEMENT → MEASURE → OPTIMIZE → SCALE → GROW TOGETHER**

**Initial Monthly Payout: INR 10,000–15,000**

My Wellness Community (MWC) is building a scalable international wellness affiliate business. We seek a commercially minded professional who can guide us in selecting profitable affiliate offers, developing advertising strategies, testing creatives, choosing acquisition channels and building a measurable, conversion-oriented business.

**This is primarily a mentorship, strategic guidance and operational-support role—not a conventional execution position.**
MWC will undertake the actual operations. You will teach, guide, review our implementation, analyze results and recommend corrective actions to improve conversions and profitability.

**⚠️ IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING**

A VERY LOW INITIAL MONTHLY PAYOUT of INR 10,000–15,000 is a fundamental condition during MWC’s early validation stage. Performance/growth-linked compensation may be added as the business grows, subject to mutually agreed terms.

We welcome professionals with
**3–5 years of relevant experience**
, as well as more experienced consultants, freelancers and independent practitioners. Practical expertise, demonstrable results, willingness to teach and commercial thinking matter more than seniority or reputation.

This is a long-term growth-partner opportunity. The initial payout is not intended to remain low indefinitely, although future increases will depend on business growth, contribution and mutually agreed arrangements.

**🎯 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We need an
**Affiliate Marketing Mentor who can teach us how to build, operate and scale a profitable affiliate marketing business**
.

The ideal candidate combines affiliate marketing, performance marketing, direct-response advertising, advertising strategy, creative testing, channel selection, conversion optimization and campaign analytics.

Experience in AI-generated content, AI-avatar videos, short-form video creation and editing is a valuable advantage.

You will NOT be expected to execute every task personally. You must explain what to do, why, how to implement it, how to measure results and what to change when performance is unsatisfactory.

**Our objective is to build our own execution capability under your practical guidance.**

**🔥 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. AFFILIATE OFFER EVALUATION & SELECTION**

Guide us in evaluating offers based on product quality, demand, customer intent, commissions, EPC, conversion rates, average order value, recurring commissions, refund risks, competition, traffic restrictions, break-even acquisition cost and profit potential. Help identify the best offer–audience–message–channel combinations.

**2. ADVERTISING STRATEGY & DIRECT-RESPONSE CREATIVES**

Teach us to develop conversion-focused advertising based on customer research, including pain-point, problem/solution, curiosity, benefit-driven, educational, comparison, myth/fact, buying-guide, objection-handling, story-based and offer-driven angles.

Guide the development of hooks, headlines, copy, CTAs, static ads, carousels, short-form videos, Reels/Shorts, advertorials and landing-page messaging. Explain which angle suits which audience and purchase-intent stage.

**3. CREATIVE TESTING & OPTIMIZATION**

Help us test hooks, headlines, opening frames, images, videos, copy, offers, audiences, CTAs, landing-page messages, formats and channels.

**TEST → MEASURE → IDENTIFY WINNERS → IMPROVE → RETEST → SCALE.**

We need a data-led testing framework, not speculation. Review our findings and recommend the next experiments.

**4. CONVERSION GROWTH & FUNNEL OPTIMIZATION**

Guide us through the complete funnel:

Impression → Click → Landing Page → Affiliate Click → Purchase → Commission → Profit.

Help diagnose low CTR, high CPC/CPM/CAC, weak messaging, poor targeting, low conversion rates, low EPC, creative fatigue, landing-page problems and unprofitable acquisition. Identify funnel leaks and recommend actionable solutions.

**5. PAID MEDIA, NATIVE ADS, PR/NEWS & CHANNEL SELECTION**

Guide us in choosing suitable acquisition and promotional channels for each offer, audience and objective.

Potential channels include:

* **Social Advertising:**
  Facebook and Instagram.
* **Search & Video:**
  Google Search and YouTube.
* **Community & Question-Based Platforms:**
  Reddit and Quora, including paid advertising, audience research, customer-intent discovery and compliant participation.
* **Visual Discovery:**
  Pinterest and other relevant platforms.
* **Native Advertising:**
  Native ad networks, sponsored content, advertorials and recommendation-widget placements.
* **PR & News/Media:**
  Relevant digital publications, online news platforms, media partnerships, sponsored articles and suitable editorial/promotional placements.
* **Affiliate & Publisher Partnerships:**
  Affiliate networks, publisher partnerships and performance-based traffic sources.
* **Other Channels:**
  Additional cost-effective sources with credible conversion potent

title: SEO DEVELOPER (Kolkata)
company: SEO ORB - The Growth Acceleration Framework™
description:
**SEO Executive: Strategy, Development & AI Content**

Location:
**New Alipore, Kolkata (**
Commute should not be a problem)

 Employment Type: Full-Time (On-site)

 Experience: 3 to 5 years

 Salary: INR 25,000 to 40,000 per month (based on experience)

 Working Hours: 10:30 AM to 7:30 PM, Monday to Saturday

**About Massive Impact**

Massive Impact is a Kolkata-based digital marketing agency serving escape rooms, event venues, and SaaS businesses across the US, UK, Australia, and Europe. We build websites, run ads, and handle SEO for all of them, in-house.

**The Role**

You'll own the SEO work that actually moves client rankings, keyword and competitor strategy, on-page execution, citation and profile management across every client, monthly reporting, and you'll be able to get your hands into the actual codebase, WordPress or React, when the work calls for it, using AI tools to move fast without cutting corners.

**What You'll Do**

* Run keyword research, keyword mapping, and competitor analysis, and turn it into actual on-page and content priorities for each client.
* Handle on-page and basic technical SEO across client websites: titles, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, schema, and general site health, using AI coding tools like Claude Code to speed up bulk checks and fixes.
* Make front-end fixes and small builds directly in our WordPress and React/Next.js sites when the SEO work needs a code change, not just a brief handed to someone else.
* Build and maintain citations and business profiles, including Google Business Profile, for every client, and keep them accurate and consistent over time.
* Use AI tools to write SEO content, such as blog posts, location pages, and service pages, and publish it directly on client websites.
* Prepare monthly SEO performance reports: rankings, organic traffic, and what changes next, for each client.



**Must Have**

* Real hands-on experience with keyword research, keyword mapping, and competitor analysis, not just execution off someone else's keyword list.
* On-page optimization and basic technical SEO fixes.
* Practical experience managing citations and business profiles, including Google Business Profile and directory listings, for multiple clients, keeping details accurate and consistent.
* Working knowledge of WordPress: can make on-page and content edits directly.
* React or Next.js and Node.js at a real project level, not tutorial depth, able to make an actual code change and understand what it does.
* Real, hands-on experience using Claude Code, or a similar agentic AI coding tool, for actual work: bulk technical checks, small scripts, or automated fixes. This is one of the things we're weighting most heavily, so be ready to be specific about what you've actually built or automated with it.
* Genuine daily use of AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT for content and research work, not casual or occasional use.
* Can put together a clear, client-ready report from Google Search Console, GA4, and a rank tracker.
* Confident written English. Most of our clients are in the US.



**Nice to Have**

* Working knowledge of Postgres or another relational database.
* Familiarity with citation or local SEO tools such as BrightLocal or Whitespark.
* Working knowledge of Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Screaming Frog.
* Experience with local, booking-led businesses: escape rooms, event venues, or similar.



**How We Hire**

A short screening call, followed by a working interview built around real keyword, on-page, development, and AI-workflow tasks, not textbook SEO trivia.

Language: English (Mandatory)

title: Manager – Strategic Partnerships & Banking Alliances
description:
***Job Title***
: Manager – Strategic Partnerships & Banking Alliances

***Company***
: UnPay Innovation Private Limited

***Location***
: Salt Lake, Sector V, Kolkata, West Bengal

***Department***
: Business Development & Strategic Partnerships

***Employment Type***
: Full-Time, Work from Office

***Experience***
: 3–6 Years

**About UnPay :**

UnPay Innovation Private Limited is a fintech technology company building financial infrastructure for businesses, financial institutions and fintech companies. Our product portfolio includes Connected Banking, Payment Gateway, Payouts, Payment Collections, Lending OS, Loan Management System, Loan Origination System, KYC and Identity Verification, and Financial Operations solutions.

We aim to simplify financial operations through technology and strategic partnerships with banks, payment providers and other financial institutions.

**About the Role :**

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented professional to manage strategic partnerships and banking alliances at UnPay. The role involves identifying new partnership opportunities, building relationships with banks and fintech companies, negotiating commercial arrangements and driving partnerships from initial discussions through onboarding and production launch.

The ideal candidate should understand the Indian banking and fintech ecosystem, possess strong relationship management skills and be capable of converting business opportunities into long-term, commercially viable partnerships.

**Key Responsibilities :**

* Identify and develop partnerships with banks, small finance banks, payment aggregators, payment gateway providers, NBFCs and other fintech companies.
* Build relationships with key decision-makers across banking, payments, transaction banking, digital banking and financial services.
* Explore partnership opportunities for Connected Banking, UPI, payment gateways, payouts, collections, virtual accounts and other financial technology products.
* Research potential partners, understand their requirements and identify opportunities aligned with UnPay's business objectives.
* Prepare partnership proposals, business presentations, commercial models and revenue-sharing structures.
* Lead partnership discussions, commercial negotiations and coordination for agreements.
* Work closely with internal product, engineering, legal, compliance and operations teams to facilitate partner onboarding and integration.
* Coordinate documentation, due diligence, API integration, UAT and production activation with relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain a structured pipeline of prospective partners and ensure timely follow-ups and progress reporting.
* Represent UnPay in industry meetings, networking events and business discussions.
* Identify opportunities to expand existing partnerships, develop new revenue channels and strengthen UnPay's market presence.

**Required Qualifications and Experience :**

* 3–6 years of experience in banking partnerships, fintech business development, payment alliances or financial services.
* Good understanding of the Indian banking and payments ecosystem.
* Experience working with banks, payment companies, NBFCs or financial technology providers.
* Knowledge of payment gateways, UPI, payouts, banking APIs, virtual accounts or payment collections.
* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation and relationship management skills.
* Ability to identify relevant decision-makers and independently initiate business discussions.
* Experience preparing business proposals, negotiating commercial terms and managing partnership pipelines.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with technical and non-technical teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM or business pipeline management tools.

**Preferred Candidate Profile :**

Candidates with experience in banking alliances, transaction banking, API banking, payment infrastructure or fintech partnerships will be preferred.

Existing professional relationships with banks and payment ecosystem participants, along with a demonstrated record of developing and executing partnerships, will be an advantage.

**Performance Expectations :**

The selected candidate will be expected to build a qualified partnership pipeline, develop strategic relationships, progress commercial negotiations, facilitate partner onboarding and contribute to business growth through activated partnerships.

Performance will be evaluated based on partnership quality, agreements executed, integrations launched, business opportunities generated and revenue contribution.

title: Territory Manager (Kolkata)
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
As a Territory Manager based in Kolkata, you will play a crucial role in driving our business with a primary focus on
**Retail promotion**
alongside vital
**Doctor/HCP support**
. You will champion our
**OTC (Over the counter)**
and
**OTX (Over The Counter and Prescription)**
portfolios, ensuring our products effectively penetrate the pharmacy and retail markets. By managing distribution networks, executing sales promotion plans, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM), you will help us achieve our business goals.
  
  
**The Opportunity**

* Drive Retail Growth (Main Line Business): Lead retail sales and market penetration by building strong, lasting relationships with pharmacies, chemists, and retail partners to ensure optimal placement and movement of our OTC and OTX product lines
* HCP Support: Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through targeted scientific communication, relationship building, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and support OTX prescriptions
* Territory Planning: Assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing retail market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials
* Merchandising & Activation: Prepare and execute monthly retail sales promotion plans—including in-store field activation and pharmacy merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy
* Target Achievement: Ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the retail market
* Network Management: Manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones
* Stakeholder Engagement: Motivate distributors, dealers, and retail chemists through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes
* Strategic Meetings & Collections: Organize distributor and retail dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups
* Market Intelligence: Act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities in the retail space, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your visits

**Who You Are**

* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field
* You have proven practical experience in pharmacy sales, distribution management, or a territory management role
* Product Expertise: You bring highly preferred experience working with OTC (over-the-counter) and/or OTX (Over-the-Counter and Prescription) pharmaceutical products
* You have a strong interest in driving retail market growth, with a focus on pharmacy relationship building, demand generation, and executing in-store marketing strategies
* You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Chemist, dealer, and Doctor interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings
* You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/weekly/monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections
* You are comfortable with field travel within the Kolkata territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

title: Sales And Marketing Representative
description:
**Company Description**
Labridge is a fast-growing B2B partner in healthcare, building and supporting a robust network of diagnostic centers across India. The company offers competitive B2B rates for blood and RT-PCR sample processing, along with integrated logistics, IT, and marketing support to partner laboratories. Through its dedicated marketplace, Labridge provides high-quality consumables at optimized prices, helping partners reduce operational costs. By emphasizing service excellence, faster turnaround times, and reliable reporting, Labridge enables diagnostic centers to scale effectively and deliver improved patient care. Guided by the principles of precision, trust, and growth, Labridge is expanding its impact within the healthcare diagnostics ecosystem.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role for a Sales and Marketing Representative based in Kolkata. The role involves identifying and engaging potential diagnostic center partners, presenting Labridge’s services and marketplace offerings, and managing the full sales cycle from lead generation to closing. The representative will nurture existing client relationships, provide ongoing customer support, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth service delivery and issue resolution. Daily activities include conducting field visits, preparing and delivering sales presentations, collecting market intelligence, and maintaining accurate records of interactions and performance metrics. The role also involves supporting marketing initiatives, participating in promotional campaigns and events, and contributing feedback to refine sales and marketing strategies.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills to interact effectively with clients, colleagues, and stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to handle inquiries, resolve issues, and maintain long-term professional relationships.
* Candidates should possess Sales skills to prospect, present solutions, negotiate, and close deals in a B2B environment.
* Candidates should possess Sales & Marketing skills to support promotional activities, understand market trends, and contribute to growth strategies.
* Candidates should possess Training-related skills to educate partner staff on services, processes, and tools as needed.
* Relevant experience in healthcare, diagnostics, or B2B services is beneficial.
* Ability to work on-site in Kolkata, manage field activities, and travel locally as required.
* Proficiency in basic IT tools (CRM systems, spreadsheets, presentations) and data reporting is an advantage.
* A bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, life sciences, or a related field is preferred.

title: SEO Executive
description:

title: Head – Product Approvals (Government & Institutional Projects)
description:
**SRMB STEEL is Hiring : Brand Approval Head (Steel & Building Materials)**

**• Location: Kolkata / Delhi-NCR**

**• Employment Type: Full-time**

**• Vertical: Government, Private & Institutional Project Sales**

**• Reporting To: VP - Institutional Sales**

**About the Role**

**We are looking for a strategic and seasoned Brand Approval Head to spearhead our product approvals, brand specifications, and empanelment's across government, private, and institutional construction projects. You will lead and mentor a zone-wise team of Regional, Brand Approval Managers, driving high-level ministry PR, stakeholder engagement, and an evidence-based approval pipeline to convert specifications into verified business outcomes.**

**Key Focus Sectors & Project Coverage**

**• Government & Public Sector (incl. Ministries): PSUs, State PWDs, housing boards,urban development authorities, Zonal Railways, RVNL, Metro Railways, DFCCIL, NHAI,**

**MoRTH, CPWD, defense agencies, and key ministries via high-impact PR and advocacy.**

**• Refineries, Power & Petrochemicals: Major public/private energy complexes and heavy industrial plant expansions.**

**• Real Estate & Private Sector: Leading private developers and housing/commercial builders.**

**• Structural Consultants & Architects: Key design bodies and engineering consultants shaping material selection at the Detailed Project Report (DPR) stage.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**• Leadership & Team Management: Direct, mentor, and expand a zone-wise team of Regional Brand Approval Managers.**

**• Ministry & Government PR: Lead high-level stakeholder relations, advocacy, and networking across government departments and ministries.**

**• Approval Pipeline Ownership: Own the documented approval routes—covering manufacturer registration, brand acceptance, vendor empanelment, and project-specific approvals.**

**• Technical & Consultant Alignment: Oversee technical submissions, plant inspections, and coordination with Quality, Manufacturing, and Technical Services while engaging. structural consultants during DPR formulation.**

**• Business Attribution: Link approvals directly to tender eligibility, contractor enquiries, and sales handover, tracking metrics in volume (MT) and revenue.**

**Candidate Profile & Qualifications**

**• Education: BE / BTech in Civil, Metallurgical, or Mechanical Engineering (MBA/Postgraduate in Management preferred).**

**• Experience: 12+ years in the steel or building materials industry, with at least 5 years leading government/institutional approvals and technical marketing, backed by a proven leadership track record.**

**• Core Competencies:**

**- Proven expertise in high-level government liaisoning and ministry-level PR.**

**- Experience managing multi-region/zone-wise technical sales or approval teams.**

**- Deep technical understanding of TMT reinforcement, structural steel, BIS standards (e.g.,IS 1786), and testing requirements.**

**- Strong existing networks with structural consultants, specifiers, and institutional decision-makers.**

**What We Offer**

**• A high-impact leadership role shaping national infrastructure and industrial growth.**

**• The opportunity to build and mentor a high-performing pan-India approval team.**

**• Competitive compensation aligned with executive responsibilities.**

**Role Overview**

**App Marketing Executive**

.

**app marketing, user engagement, CRM, ASO, content, analytics, and performance marketing**
skills.

**1. New User Welcome & Onboarding**

•  Own the welcome experience for new app users.

◦   Browsing cards

◦   Creating/sending an eCard

◦   Saving a favorite

◦   Sharing a card

◦   Subscribing to Pro

•  Develop welcome journeys for different user segments and acquisition sources.

•  Continuously analyze the onboarding funnel and identify opportunities to improve activation and retention.

**2. Push Notification & User Engagement**

•  Own the complete push notification strategy for the 123Greetings apps.

•  Develop engaging, timely and relevant push campaigns around:

◦   Birthdays

◦   Holidays

◦   Festivals

◦   Seasonal occasions

◦   Friendship and relationships

◦   Important calendar events

◦   New card launches

◦   Trending occasions

◦   Pro subscription

•  Test different notification:

◦   Headlines

◦   Copy

◦   Timing

◦   Frequency

◦   CTAs

•  Monitor open rates, click-through rates, card sends, conversions and unsubscribe/opt-out rates.

•  Build automated notification journeys wherever possible.

•  Ensure notifications add value and do not result in notification fatigue.

**3. 123Greetings Website → App Growth**

•  Own the 123Greetings App page/section on the website homepage.

•  Develop strategies to convert website visitors into app users.

◦   App promotion placements

◦   App banners

◦   App download CTAs

◦   QR codes

◦   App landing pages

◦   Website-to-app journeys

•  Develop campaigns that leverage the existing 123Greetings website audience to increase app downloads.

Own the ongoing
**ASO strategy**
for both iOS and Android apps.

Responsibilities include:

•  Keyword research and optimization.

•  App title and subtitle optimization.

•  App description optimization.

•  Keyword optimization.

•  App screenshots and creative optimization.

•  App icon testing and optimization.

•  Store listing localization where relevant.

•  Competitor ASO research.

•  Monitoring app-store rankings and visibility.

•  Improving conversion from store visit → install.

•  Managing seasonal ASO updates around major occasions and holidays.

•  Conducting A/B tests on store creatives and messaging wherever available.

**5. App Install & Download Growth**

Develop and execute an overall marketing strategy to increase
**qualified app installs and downloads**
.

Channels may include:

•  123Greetings website

•  Email marketing

•  Push notifications

•  Social media

•  Organic search

•  App Store / Google Play optimization

•  Paid digital advertising

•  Influencer/creator partnerships

•  Affiliate partnerships

•  Content marketing

•  Referral campaigns

•  Cross-promotion

•  Seasonal campaigns

•  PR and media outreach

•  Partnerships and co-marketing

•  QR-code campaigns

•  Offline-to-online campaigns

•  Retargeting

**6. App Engagement & Retention**

•  Develop strategies to increase DAU/MAU and user retention.

•  Identify reasons for user drop-off after installation.

•  Create re-engagement campaigns for inactive users.

•  Build lifecycle campaigns

123Greetings is an occasion-driven product, so the person will be responsible for creating an annual
**App Marketing Calendar**
covering major:

•  U.S. holidays

•  Birthdays

•  Relationship occasions

•  Festivals

•  Awareness days

•  Seasonal events

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
**Job Description**
About the Team
  
  
The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes, not just a platform.
  
  
You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."
  
  
Role Description
  
  
As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.
  
  
You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.
  
  
This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.
  
  
The impact you will have
  
  

* C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.
* End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.
* Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.
* Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.
* Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for
  
  

* Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.
* Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.
* Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.
* Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.
* Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
  
  
**Benefits**
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
  
  
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
  
  
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

title: Social Media Growth Strategist
description:
**Company Description**
Marketing Lab is a team of unconventional, creative marketers based in Kolkata, focused on practical, results-driven digital marketing. The company values experimentation, data-backed decisions, and delivering measurable value to clients. Marketing Lab rejects unnecessary jargon and focuses on strategies that directly impact growth. Team members are encouraged to think independently, challenge assumptions, and prioritize impact over appearances.

Experience: 2+ years

We're looking for a Social Media Growth Strategist who understands that social media is not just about posting consistently, making reels, or coming up with content ideas. It's about understanding what makes people stop scrolling, watch, engage, follow, share, and eventually become customers.

The Role: We Want a Growth Thinker

Let's be clear about what we're looking for.

We are NOT looking for someone who can simply brainstorm content ideas, prepare a content calendar, coordinate with a designer, and ensure posts go live on time.

We are looking for someone who can take a social media account, understand where it stands today, identify what's holding it back, and build a strategy to grow it.

Someone who constantly asks:

Why is this account not growing despite posting regularly?

Why did one reel get 500,000 views while another barely reached 2,000?

What are competitors doing differently that we can learn from?

Which content formats are driving reach, shares, saves, profile visits, and followers?

How do we turn one successful piece of content into a repeatable growth system?

What should we stop doing, what should we double down on, and what should we experiment with next?

We want someone who can think, analyse, experiment, execute, and take ownership of the growth numbers.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Own Social Media Growth Strategy

Take complete ownership of growing social media accounts across Instagram, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.

Audit existing accounts to identify gaps in content, positioning, audience engagement, reach, and follower growth.

Develop platform-specific growth strategies based on the brand, audience, competition, and business objectives.

Build clear monthly growth plans with measurable targets for reach, engagement, profile visits, followers, and other relevant metrics.

Identify the right content mix, formats, themes, and publishing frequency for each account.

2.Use Data to Make Better Content Decisions

**Analyse content performance at the individual post and account level.**

**Understand metrics such as reach, watch time, retention, shares, saves, engagement rate, profile visits, and follower conversion.**

**Identify patterns behind high-performing and underperforming content.**

**Develop hypotheses, run experiments, and use results to continuously improve the content strategy.**

**Move beyond vanity metrics and understand which content attracts the right audience and contributes to brand growth.**

3.Build a Repeatable Content Growth Engine

**Develop content pillars, recurring series, platform-native formats, and creative concepts that can be scaled.**

**Study trends, competitors, audience conversations, and platform behaviour to identify growth opportunities.**

**Understand hooks, storytelling, pacing, retention, shareability, and the psychology behind content consumption.**

**Create repeatable frameworks from successful content rather than relying on random viral hits.**

**Explore founder-led content, UGC, educational content, entertainment-led content, community-building formats, and other relevant approaches.**

4.Drive Strategy Through Execution

**Translate strategy into actionable briefs, scripts, content calendars, and production plans.**

**Work closely with copywriters, designers, video editors, creators, and account managers to get content made and published.**

**Review creative output critically and ensure every piece of content has a clear objective.**

**Track content performance after publishing and use insights to brief the next iteration.**

**Stay hands-on throughout the process instead of treating strategy as a document that someone else has to execute.**

5.Own Growth Experiments and Continuous Improvement

**Test different hooks, formats, storytelling styles, lengths, posting patterns, and creative approaches.**

**Develop a structured experimentation roadmap for every account.**

**Identify opportunities to improve organic distribution, audience retention, community engagement, and follower conversion.**

**Build playbooks documenting what works, why it works, and how it can be replicated.**

**Stay updated on platform changes and emerging content formats without blindly following every trend.**

6.Collaborate With the Wider Marketing Team

**Work with performance marketing teams to identify opportunities to repurpose high-performing organic content into paid ads.**

**Align social media strategy with brand positioning, campaign objectives, launches, and business goals.**

**Present performance reports that explain not just what happened, but why it happened and what should happen next.**

**What We're Looking For**

**2+ years of experience in social media strategy, organic growth, content strategy, or a similar role.**

**A proven track record of growing social media accounts, preferably on Instagram and YouTube.**

**Strong analytical thinking and the ability to derive actionable insights from content performance data.**

**A deep understanding of short-form video, hooks, storytelling, retention, shareability, and audience behaviour.**

**The ability to connect creative thinking with measurable outcomes.**

**A test-and-learn mindset: you form hypotheses, run experiments, analyse results, and iterate.**

**Strong communication skills and the ability to brief and guide creative teams.**

**A high degree of ownership, curiosity, and willingness to get into the details.**

**Comfort working across multiple brands, categories, and business objectives in an agency environment.**

**What Will Make You Stand Out**

**You have personally grown an account from a small following to a meaningful audience and can explain how you did it.**

**You can show before-and-after account metrics and explain the decisions that drove growth.**

**You understand why some content gets distributed widely while other content doesn't.**

**You can look at an underperforming account and identify specific opportunities within the first hour.**

**You can distinguish between a video that gets views and a video that attracts the right audience.**

**You have built repeatable content formats or series that consistently generate results.**

**You have examples of experiments that failed, what you learned, and how you adapted.**

**You use analytics to challenge assumptions rather than simply validate creative opinions.**

**How Success Will Be Measured**

**Your performance will be evaluated on your ability to drive sustainable, measurable growth, including:**

**Growth in relevant followers and the rate of follower acquisition.**

**Improvement in non-follower reach and content discovery.**

**Watch time and audience retention on video content.**

**Shares, saves, meaningful engagement, and profile visits.**

**Conversion of reach and profile visits into followers.**

**Consistency of successful content formats and improvement in overall account performance.**

**Quality of experimentation, insights, and strategic recommendations.**

**Contribution to the brand's broader marketing and business objectives.**

**Targets will be defined account by account, considering the starting point, category, audience, and available resources. We care about meaningful growth, not inflated numbers.**

**The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here**

**You are curious about why content works. You study social media accounts even when nobody asks you to. You notice patterns others miss. You don't blame an algorithm when a post underperforms — you investigate what could have been better.**

**You enjoy both the creative and analytical sides of social media. You can come up with an idea, explain why it should work, brief the team to execute it, study the results, and improve the next iteration.**

**Most importantly, you don't measure your work by how many posts went live. You measure it by how much the account grew and what you learned along the way.**

* **If you believe social media growth requires strategic thinking, experimentation, and relentless execution — rather than just a content calendar — we'd love to meet you.**

title: Customer Manager, Building & Infrastructure
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
  
  
Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**About You And This Role**
As a
**Customer Manager**
, based in
**Kolkata, India**
, you will be a dynamic and self-motivated commercial professional who combines strategic thinking with disciplined execution to drive profitable growth. In this role, you will lead the
**Building & Infrastructure**
business across
**Eastern India and Bangladesh**
, with responsibility for key market segments including
**Projects, Retail, Construction Chemicals, and other strategic growth areas**
.
  
  
You will be responsible for developing and executing growth strategies, identifying and converting new business opportunities, strengthening strategic customer relationships, and expanding Dow’s route-to-market network. This includes working closely with distributors, dealers, retailers, hardware stores, contractors, applicators, and other key industry stakeholders. You will be equally effective in engaging customers at the point of sale, influencing project stakeholders, and presenting market insights, business strategies, and growth recommendations to senior leadership.
  
  
Success in this role requires the ability to combine customer insights, channel development expertise, project specification influence, value-based selling, and cross-functional collaboration to accelerate market penetration and drive sustainable business growth. Your ability to translate market trends and customer needs into actionable commercial strategies will be instrumental in strengthening Dow’s market position and delivering long-term business success.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute growth strategies for the Building & Infrastructure business across Eastern India and Bangladesh, with a strong focus on Projects, Retail, Construction Chemicals, and other designated market segments.
* Expand and strengthen the retail route-to-market by developing high-performing networks of distributors, dealers, retailers, hardware stores, contractors, applicators, and other channel partners to maximize market reach and customer adoption.
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with developers, architects, consultants, contractors, fabricators, and other key decision-makers to influence specifications and secure project opportunities.
* Identify, qualify, and convert new business opportunities while maintaining a robust sales pipeline, accurate forecasts, and disciplined opportunity management from inception through closure.
* Drive value-based selling initiatives, commercial negotiations, pricing strategies, and joint business plans that contribute to revenue growth, margin expansion, customer retention, and channel excellence.
* Collaborate closely with Marketing, Product Management, Technical Service, Supply Chain, and Customer Service teams to deliver customer value while providing market intelligence, competitive insights, and business updates to senior stakeholders.

**Qualifications**
To be successful in this role, you should possess:
  
  

* A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Architecture, Business, or a related field from a recognized institution. An MBA or Master's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred.
* 10-12 years of experience in sales, business development, account management, project sales, channel development, market development, or related commercial roles.
* Proven experience serving customers within the Building & Infrastructure, Construction Chemicals, Building Materials, Architectural Solutions, or related industries.
* Demonstrated success in developing and growing markets through distributors, dealers, retailers, hardware stores, contractors, applicators, and similar channel partners across geographically diverse regions.
* Experience managing strategic accounts, major projects, and specification-driven opportunities while influencing a broad range of stakeholders involved in purchasing decisions.
* A proven track record of independently developing markets, converting opportunities into sustainable business growth, and presenting business strategies and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively across Eastern India and Bangladesh.

**Your Skills**

* Market development and growth strategy, with the ability to transform customer, channel, and competitive insights into executable business plans.
* Channel and retail development, including distributor management, dealer expansion, outlet penetration, and demand generation.
* Strategic account and project management, including stakeholder mapping, specification influence, and opportunity conversion.
* Value-based selling, commercial negotiations, and development of differentiated solutions that create customer value.
* Business planning and commercial analytics, including sales forecasting, pipeline management, performance tracking, and corrective action planning.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively present business strategies, market intelligence, and growth recommendations.

**Additional Notes**

* This position supports market development activities across Eastern India and Bangladesh.
* The business portfolio includes Projects, Retail, Construction Chemicals, and other designated Building & Infrastructure market segments.
* Extensive travel is required to develop customer relationships, strengthen channel networks, support project opportunities, and identify new areas for business growth.
* Relocation support is not available for this position.

We invest in you.
  
  
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
  
  
Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:

Join our team, we can make a difference together.

title: Digital Marketing AEO Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Global Offshore Consulting Services (GOCS) delivers cutting-edge IT solutions that help enterprises worldwide drive growth, improve efficiency, and strengthen competitive advantage. The company offers tailored services across Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security, Data Engineering, Cloud Computing, and Technology Transformation. Its consulting and implementation capabilities extend to Finance & Risk Management, Business Process Services, and workflow automation. Global Offshore Consulting Services also provides staff augmentation, allowing organizations to scale quickly with skilled professionals and accelerate delivery on critical projects.

About the Role

We are looking for a
**Digital Marketing & AEO Specialist**
to drive our brand's visibility across traditional search engines and the rapidly growing ecosystem of
**AI-powered search and answer engines**
.

The role will focus on making our brand, products, services, and content more likely to be
**discovered, cited, recommended, and accurately represented by AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot, and other emerging AI search experiences**
.

This is not simply an SEO role. We are looking for someone who understands how
**SEO, content, digital PR, structured data, brand authority, entity optimization, and AI-generated answers**
work together.

Key Responsibilities1. Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)

* Develop and execute an AEO strategy to increase brand visibility in AI-generated answers.
* Research how target customers phrase questions when using ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, and other AI assistants.
* Identify high-value conversational queries, informational questions, comparison queries, and commercial-intent prompts.
* Optimize website and content to improve the likelihood of being
  **understood, surfaced, cited, and recommended by AI systems**
  .
* Develop content structures that provide clear, authoritative, machine-readable answers.
* Track brand mentions, citations, recommendations, and competitor visibility across AI platforms.
* Identify gaps where competitors are being surfaced by AI systems but our brand is not.
* Develop strategies to improve brand/entity recognition and topical authority.

2. AI Search & Generative Search Optimization

* Monitor developments in
  **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AEO, AI Search Optimization, and AI visibility**
  .
* Analyze AI-generated search results and identify factors influencing visibility and citations.
* Test different content formats, structures, entities, terminology, and information architecture.
* Build prompt/query libraries for systematic AI visibility testing.
* Measure changes in AI visibility over time and translate findings into actionable marketing initiatives.
* Keep the organization informed about major changes in AI search behavior and platforms.

3. SEO & Organic Growth

* Develop and execute on-page and technical SEO initiatives.
* Conduct keyword, topic, entity, competitor, and search-intent research.
* Build topic clusters and content strategies around high-value customer journeys.
* Optimize titles, headings, metadata, internal linking, URLs, schema markup, and content structure.
* Work with developers to improve technical SEO, crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, structured data, and website architecture.
* Identify opportunities from Google Search Console, GA4, SEO tools, and other analytics platforms.

4. Content Strategy

* Create and manage content strategies designed for both humans and AI systems.
* Develop briefs for blogs, landing pages, FAQs, comparison pages, product pages, guides, and thought-leadership content.
* Ensure content demonstrates expertise, credibility, originality, and clear first-hand value.
* Identify questions that should be answered directly on owned digital properties.
* Develop FAQ and knowledge-base strategies around high-intent customer questions.
* Work with writers, subject-matter experts, designers, and product teams to produce authoritative content.

5. Digital PR & Authority Building

* Develop strategies to increase credible third-party references to the brand.
* Identify publications, industry websites, directories, communities, podcasts, research sources, and other authoritative platforms where the brand should have a presence.
* Support digital PR, thought leadership, expert commentary, link acquisition, and brand mention campaigns.
* Identify authoritative sources that AI systems are likely to use when constructing answers.
* Build strategies for strengthening the brand's digital footprint and entity authority.

6. AI Visibility Measurement & Analytics

Create and maintain an
**AI Visibility Dashboard**
covering metrics such as:

* AI brand mentions
* AI citations
* Citation share
* AI recommendation frequency
* Share of voice versus competitors
* Visibility for priority prompts
* Product/service inclusion in AI answers
* Accuracy of AI-generated information about the brand
* Sentiment/context of AI mentions
* Referral traffic from AI platforms where measurable
* Organic search visibility
* Organic traffic and conversions

Regularly report insights, trends, opportunities, and recommended actions to the marketing team.

Required Skills & Experience

* 2–5 years of experience in
  **SEO, digital marketing, content marketing, growth marketing, or a related field**
  .
* Strong understanding of SEO fundamentals and search intent.
* Practical understanding of
  **AEO, GEO, Generative Search, AI Search, or AI visibility optimization**
  .
* Hands-on familiarity with ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and similar AI platforms.
* Strong content strategy and content optimization skills.
* Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics/GA4.
* Understanding of structured data/schema markup, internal linking, crawlability, indexation, and technical SEO.
* Strong analytical and research skills.
* Ability to convert data and AI-search observations into actionable marketing strategies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working on
  **AI search visibility or AEO/GEO projects**
  .
* Experience with SEO platforms such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Similarweb, or equivalent tools.
* Understanding of knowledge graphs, entities, structured data, and semantic search.
* Experience with digital PR or link-building.
* Basic understanding of HTML, JSON-LD, APIs, and web technologies.
* Experience running experiments and documenting AI-search results.
* Familiarity with prompt engineering and LLM evaluation methodologies.
* Experience working with B2B SaaS, technology, e-commerce, healthcare, finance, education, or other competitive digital markets.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 6–12 months, you will be expected to:

* Establish a baseline for the company's
  **AI search visibility**
  .
* Build a prioritized database of high-value prompts and customer questions.
* Increase the frequency and quality of brand mentions/citations across relevant AI platforms.
* Improve visibility for strategically important commercial and informational queries.
* Identify and close content gaps against competitors.
* Build scalable AEO/GEO processes that can be integrated into the company's broader SEO and content program.
* Establish regular reporting on AI visibility and its relationship to organic traffic, leads, and revenue.
* Help position the company as a credible and authoritative source within its target category.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

**AI / AEO**

* AI visibility/share of voice
* Brand mention rate
* Citation rate
* Recommendation rate
* Priority-query coverage
* Competitor visibility gap
* Accuracy of brand/product information in AI answers

**SEO**

* Organic impressions
* Organic rankings
* Non-branded organic traffic
* Featured snippets / SERP features
* Indexed pages
* Organic conversions

**Business**

* Qualified organic leads
* Conversion rate
* Revenue influenced by organic/AI channels
* Cost per acquisition
* Growth in branded demand

Ideal Candidate

You are someone who:

* Thinks beyond traditional Google rankings.
* Understands that
  **search is moving from "10 blue links" toward AI-generated answers and recommendations**
  .
* Enjoys experimenting with emerging technology rather than waiting for established playbooks.
* Can combine SEO, content, analytics, technical concepts, and marketing strategy.
* Is comfortable testing hypotheses instead of relying on assumptions.
* Can distinguish genuine AI-search optimization opportunities from hype.
* Understands that getting cited by AI requires building
  **real authority and useful information**
  , not simply manipulating prompts or producing large volumes of AI-generated content.

Why Join Us?

You will have the opportunity to help build our
**AI Search / AEO capability from the ground up**
and shape how the company is discovered across the next generation of search and information platforms.

This role sits at the intersection of:

**Digital Marketing + SEO + Content + AI + Data + Growth**

* **and offers significant ownership over an emerging and strategically important marketing channel.**

QYUBIC is a performance marketing ecosystem company helping brands reach customers and drive measurable business results across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and the wider MENA region.

is our creator marketing business, helping brands turn creator partnerships into measurable business growth.

We’re looking for a commercially driven sales professional to acquire new clients and grow QYUBIC X.

Working directly with the Head of Partnerships, you’ll identify prospects, engage decision-makers, pitch solutions, negotiate commercial terms, and close new partnerships. You’ll have ownership of new business development and the opportunity to contribute directly to the growth of our creator marketing business.

Experience in influencer marketing is an advantage, but not essential. We welcome proven B2B sales professionals from digital advertising, media, marketing agencies, affiliate marketing, adtech, SaaS, and other B2B services.

* **Generate new business:**

* Strong prospecting, presentation, communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage a sales pipeline, work towards targets and operate independently in a remote environment.

Experience in one or more of the following areas is beneficial:

* Influencer marketing solutions selling, creator partnerships or talent agencies
* Digital advertising, media sales or marketing agencies
* Affiliate marketing, partnerships or performance marketing
* Adtech, martech, SaaS or other B2B services

Experience working with brands in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, or the wider GCC/MENA region is a plus. Familiarity with commission-based partnerships, affiliate models, CPA/CPI, campaign tracking, or performance-based pricing is also beneficial.

* New clients and partnerships signed

title: Marketing Business Development Manager
description:
Job Description: Marketing & Business Development Manager
  
  
Company: Medcore pvt ltd
  
Industry: US Healthcare – Medical Billing & Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
  
Location: Kolkata, India
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
Experience: 4–7 years
  
Role Focus: B2B Lead Generation, Client Acquisition & Revenue Growth
  
  
About MEDCORE:
  
  
MEDCORE is a growing company focused on the US healthcare medical billing and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) market. We aim to help healthcare providers streamline their billing operations and improve revenue cycle efficiency.
  
  
We are seeking a highly driven Marketing & Business Development Manager to lead our client acquisition efforts, establish a strong presence in the US market, and drive business growth.
  
  
This is a hands-on, revenue-focused role suited to someone who has successfully generated B2B leads, built sales pipelines, and acquired clients for a services business. The ideal candidate can work independently, develop acquisition strategies from scratch, and convert prospects into long-term business relationships.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Lead Generation & Prospect Acquisition
  
  
- Develop and execute a scalable lead generation strategy targeting the US healthcare market.
  
- Identify and reach decision-makers at physician practices, specialty clinics, medical groups, and other relevant healthcare organisations.
  
- Generate qualified leads through cold email outreach, LinkedIn prospecting, cold calling, targeted campaigns, referrals, and other relevant channels.
  
- Build targeted prospect databases using tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, and similar platforms.
  
- Develop ideal customer profiles, prospect lists, outreach sequences, and lead qualification criteria.
  
- Maintain a consistent pipeline of qualified prospects and sales opportunities.
  
  
2. End-to-End Client Acquisition & Sales
  
  
- Own the complete sales cycle, from initial prospecting and lead qualification to discovery calls, presentations, proposals, negotiations, and deal closure.
  
- Conduct introductory calls and communicate Medcore service offerings and value proposition to potential clients.
  
- Understand prospects' business challenges and identify opportunities where the company's medical billing and RCM services can add value.
  
- Prepare proposals, coordinate pricing discussions with leadership, manage follow-ups, and negotiate commercial terms within approved guidelines.
  
- Convert qualified prospects into signed contracts and establish strong client relationships.
  
- Coordinate onboarding handovers with the operations team after a client is acquired.
  
  
3. US Healthcare Market Development
  
  
- Research the US medical billing and RCM market, competitors, target segments, and emerging opportunities.
  
- Develop targeted acquisition strategies for relevant medical specialties and healthcare provider segments.
  
- Understand common provider challenges, including claim denials, reimbursement delays, billing inefficiencies, and accounts receivable management.
  
- Develop compelling sales messaging that communicates OneMeds' capabilities and differentiates the company from competitors.
  
- Build referral relationships and strategic partnerships that can generate qualified business opportunities.
  
  
4. Growth Marketing & Demand Generation
  
  
- Plan and execute marketing initiatives that directly support lead generation and customer acquisition.
  
- Coordinate targeted email marketing, LinkedIn campaigns, landing pages, website optimisation, SEO, and relevant digital campaigns.
  
- Develop sales collateral, service presentations, case studies, and prospect-facing content in collaboration with internal subject-matter experts.
  
- Test acquisition channels, messaging, and outreach strategies to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  
- Work closely with leadership to align marketing activities with revenue targets and business priorities.
  
  
5. CRM & Sales Pipeline Management
  
  
- Maintain an organised CRM containing prospect information, lead sources, communication history, deal stages, and follow-up actions.
  
- Track lead-to-meeting conversion, meeting-to-proposal conversion, proposal-to-client conversion, and sales cycle duration.
  
- Provide weekly pipeline reports and monthly performance updates to management.
  
- Analyse campaign and sales performance to improve acquisition efficiency and reduce wasted effort.
  
- Build a repeatable client acquisition process that can scale as the business grows.
  
  
Required Qualifications & Experience
  
  
- 4–7 years of experience in B2B business development, client acquisition, demand generation, or growth marketing.
  
- Demonstrable success in generating qualified B2B leads and converting prospects into paying clients.
  
- Preference for candidates with experience in US medical billing, healthcare RCM, healthcare outsourcing, medical coding, or healthcare technology.
  
- Experience selling services to international clients, particularly in the US market.
  
- Hands-on experience with outbound prospecting, cold email, LinkedIn outreach, lead qualification, and sales presentations.
  
- Proven ability to manage the sales pipeline and close B2B service contracts.
  
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence in dealing with US-based decision-makers.
  
- Ability to work independently, take ownership of revenue-generating activities, and operate effectively in a startup environment.
  
  
Preferred Tools & Skills
  
  
- LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  
- Apollo or equivalent B2B prospecting tools
  
- HubSpot, Salesforce, or another CRM
  
- Email outreach and sales engagement platforms
  
- Google Analytics and relevant marketing analytics tools
  
- B2B sales presentations, proposal development, negotiation, and account management
  
  
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
Performance will be evaluated primarily on measurable business development outcomes:
  
  
- Number of qualified leads generated from the target US healthcare market.
  
- Number of qualified sales meetings booked and completed.
  
- Number of proposals submitted to prospective clients.
  
- Number of new clients acquired and contracts signed.
  
- Revenue and recurring business generated from new clients.
  
- Lead-to-meeting and proposal-to-client conversion rates.
  
- Cost per qualified lead and effectiveness of acquisition channels.
  
- Consistency and accuracy of CRM updates and pipeline reporting.
  
  
Specific targets will be agreed upon based on the company's service offerings, available resources, sales cycle, and growth objectives.
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  
The ideal candidate is a commercially minded, proactive professional who combines strong lead generation capabilities with hands-on B2B sales and closing experience.
  
  
They should have a proven track record of finding prospects, initiating conversations with decision-makers, creating qualified opportunities, and winning paying clients. They must be comfortable building processes from scratch, testing new acquisition channels, and being accountable for business growth rather than focusing solely on brand awareness or social media engagement.
  
  
Application Requirements
  
  
Candidates should submit an updated CV highlighting:
  
  
- Relevant B2B client acquisition and lead generation experience.
  
- Experience in US healthcare, medical billing, RCM, or related services, where applicable.
  
- Previous client acquisition results and their individual contribution.
  
- Sales channels, prospecting tools, and CRM platforms used.
  
- Examples of measurable business development achievements.

description:
**Description**
The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer's workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and advice to customer organizations.
  
  
The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and problems. The CSM serving Marketing Cloud customers acts as the primary Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical and operational configuration and needs of the customer.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
Customer Accountability and Value Alignment
  
  

* Single Point of Accountability: Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
* Signature Lifecycle Oversight: Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
* Value Delivery: Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
* Prioritization: Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Internal Resource Utilization: Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.

**Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management**

* Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer's business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
* Innovation Partnership: Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
* Customer Engagement: Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
* Collaborative Problem Solving: Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.

**Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management**

* AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
* Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
* AI Engagement Monitoring: Using AI-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
* Collaborative Learning: Actively seeking out "Agentblazer" training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
* Learning & Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask effective diagnosis questions and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
* Proactive Reviews: Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
* Incident Management: Act as the primary point of contact for major incidents, ensuring timely communications and resolution of issues.
* Cross-functional Relationships: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
* Client Engagement Planning: Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making.

**You're Our Person If...**

* Experience (Mandatory): Experienced business professional with 9+ years of relevant industry expertise, including a mandatory minimum of 4+ years of direct, hands-on experience working with the Salesforce Marketing Cloud platform (Marketing Cloud Engagement, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement / Pardot, or Marketing Cloud Next) in a customer success, administrator, consultant, or marketing operations capacity. Candidates without demonstrated Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience will not be considered for this role.
* Consulting Skills: Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C-level conversations.
* Domain Expertise: Possess industry-relevant expertise and begin honing skills in a relevant functional area. Should understand the broad impact of the industry on the customer's business.
* Communication: Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
* Learning & Development: Actively seek out relevant learning activities, approach obstacles as growth opportunities, and seek experienced mentors to accelerate personal development.

**Even Better If...**

* Marketing Cloud Engagement Administrator — hands-on experience configuring Marketing Cloud products using industry and product best practices.
* Marketing Cloud Email Specialist — proven knowledge of email marketing best practices, message design, subscriber & data management, and inbox delivery.
* Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist — skills in designing, building, and implementing marketing workflows through the Account Engagement (Pardot) platform.
* Marketing Cloud Engagement Consultant — ability to create multi-channel campaign solutions using the full suite of Marketing Cloud tools.
