title: Strategic Builder
description:
**Description**
**The Experience**
Customer impact from day one. Strategic clarity and Execution that sticks.
  
  
Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists — Strategic Builders who are customer-facing advisors, who define AI strategy, shape agentic solutions, and drive measurable adoption for enterprise customers. You'll work as part of a delivery team alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, translating complex business challenges into agentic AI deployments that go live and generate real value.
  
  
Engagements are focused and time-bound — typically 12 weeks or less — and may span a single strategic account or multiple customers simultaneously. Your impact isn't just getting to deployment. It ensures customers realise lasting, scalable value from the solutions your team builds.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Full Lifecycle Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer engagement across the complete value lifecycle — Identify → Commit → Deploy → Consume — owning outcomes at every stage, not just discovery or deal closure
* AI Strategy & Architecture: Define the customer's Agentic AI strategy and roadmap. Lead design workshops, agent design sessions, and jobs-to-be-done analysis. Architect solutions spanning Salesforce's agentic AI platform, Data Cloud, and enterprise systems, with responsible AI governance baked in from the start.
* Deployment Oversight & Program Management: Manage engagement delivery end-to-end timelines, stakeholder communication, risk escalation, and progress reporting. You are the operational backbone of your delivery team, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
* Adoption & Consumption: Own adoption, consumption, and expansion metrics within your engagement scope. Identify blockers early and develop strategies to drive measurable value realization
* Delivery Team Coordination: Partner closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on your team to align strategy with technical execution. Keep the team focused, unblocked, and on track to hit delivery milestones.
* AI-Supported Development: You'll be developing real customer solutions supported by leading-edge AI tools: Including
* Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes, to accelerate development.
* Customer Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary customer-facing contact, building trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders and present proposals, decisions and outcomes in terms of business value, not just technical detail.
* AI Readiness: Assess customer readiness for AI adoption and guide change management and process transformation to maximise the benefits of intelligent agents
* Product Feedback Loop: Synthesise field insights and translate them into actionable product feedback that influences Salesforce's Agentic AI platform roadmap.

**You're Our Person If...**

* 10-15 years of total experience with relevant 5 years into Data & AI in strategic solutioning, technical advisory, or delivery leadership or program management for enterprise cloud or SaaS technology
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* Prior customer-facing delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or technical advisory) - this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have
* Demonstrated understanding of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including Agentic AI capabilities and Data Cloud
* Working knowledge of one or more programming languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, or Apex
* Proven ability to lead and own complex, ambiguous engagements end-to-end — from discovery through to measurable outcomes
* Experience leading AI/LLM solution design, including agentic AI strategy, conversation design, and responsible AI practices
* Strong project and program management skills — ability to run multiple workstreams, manage stakeholder expectations, and keep delivery on track in ambiguous environments
* Ability to travel 25% of the time to customer sites

**Even Better If...**

* Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce platform, and Salesforce CRM (Sales, Service, Marketing)
* Experience designing and deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., public sector, financial services, healthcare)
* Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Data Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, Application Architect) or similar platform certifications such as Microsoft, Oracle, or similar platforms.
* Background in change management, organisational design, or enterprise transformation
* Experience with AI/ML concepts beyond LLMs, including NLP, RAG architectures, and model evaluation frameworks
* A get-things-done mindset with strong bias for action — comfortable operating in unstructured fast moving environments

title: Tech S and T- Tech Strategy - Senior consultant-GDSF04
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Strategy Consultant**
**THE OPPORTUNITY:**
EY's Technology Strategy & Transformation (TST) team is at the forefront of delivering cutting-edge consulting and advisory services to some of the largest enterprises across the globe. Our technology practice is recognized by industry analysts as a leader in leveraging business and technology to drive strategic business-led, tech-enabled e2e transformation. We serve clients across all major industries and work with organizations of different sizes, helping guide them to achieve business success while delivering strategic IT value.
  
  
**Scope of engagements**
We are currently seeking experienced, seasoned IT Strategy practitioners who can be positioned at the crucial intersection of business, technology and customer to devise creative new strategies based on trends, insights and data. We are looking for folks who have experience in advising clients to …
  
  

* reset, reimagine and re-think their business and operating models with tech-enabled, cutting-edge solutions that re-energize performance across the enterprise
* set and drive enterprise tech vision and strategy in alignment with corporate / business unit strategy, customer focus and solution teams
* drive increased value from technology spend with focus on optimizing cost, agility, productivity and performance

We work with clients to address issues of importance to the Chief Information Officer (CIO) and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) in creating value and delivering world-class IT capabilities to support futuristic business needs. Working closely with our industry groups and leveraging the Ernst & Young brand as independent, trusted advisors, we provide our high-profile clients with range of services including:
  
  

* Tech Strategy & Vision
* IT Operating Model optimization
* 3/5-year Transformation strategy, roadmaps & blueprints
* Office of CIO functions (IT Finance, Sourcing, Project Portfolio Mgt. etc)
* Product strategy & management
* M&A due-diligence, planning and post integration/separation
* Enterprise Architecture Services

**Key responsibilities of candidate include:**

* Understanding the business strategy & vision and translating them into enterprise-wide technology vision & strategy in alignment with strategic priorities for growth, customer experience, efficiency etc.
* Analyze value chain and business capabilities to develop clear understanding of strategic objectives, KPI’s, processes and underlying systems that deliver the business outcomes
* Assess the impact of the business strategy on business capability model and business processes to identify optimization opportunities (through tech-enabled solutions) across organization, systems, data, infrastructure and applications
* Have strong experience in analysing business models, business model innovation/ incubation, and experience in one or more of the following areas preferred: Market Strategy, Pricing/ Monetization, Finance, Ecosystem Management, and/ or Product Management
* Ability to analyse client’s (IT) Operating Model including the organization structure, processes and governance while developing recommendations and/or creating actionable roadmaps
* Significant experience in: 1) developing business capability model for the enterprise; 2) analysing enterprise-wide portfolio of systems / platforms and 3) function as guardian of the transformation strategy and business architecture to make sure that new initiatives comply with strategic priorities
* Solid experience in guiding our clients through large, enterprise-wide transformation to implement their strategies and business architecture. Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the IT strategic and improvement agenda
* Be a trusted advisor on 'innovation' with ability to frame key business and technology trends within the context of the client's objectives. Ability to identify the potential implications and impacts of the associated trends.
* Leverage EY’s global network, and leverage the cross-functional expertise to develop relevant architecture insights

**Within the team, your role will include the following additional responsibilities:**

* Ability to lead conversations with the client stakeholders. Strong communication skills as the profile requires interactions with CIO, CEO, CFO and other senior leadership
* Build and develop trusted relationships as a strategic technology advisor with clients and work internally across EY advisory teams to bring our clients the most comprehensive, end-to-end services and effectively address their business challenges.
* Building and growing TST Strategy practice, developing and maintaining client relationships, and selling and delivering work as an engagement leader or Subject Matter Specialist.
* Develop thought leadership and define approaches to provide structured solutions to complex technology strategy problems of clients, by recombining existing methodologies and teams
* Managing engagement teams and providing leadership in the assessment, design, and management of successful Business - IT transformation engagements in collaboration with our clients. They should provide high quality client services by directing daily progress of engagement work, informing EY leadership of engagement status, and managing staff performance
* Help recruit, develop and retain strategy professionals, coach and mentor team members, deliver architecture-related training and take on other practice management tasks as needed (e.g., development of practice offerings)
* Should be very good at using various tools (Such as Word, Excel, Powerpoint, visualization tools, MS-Project, etc.)
* Would support in developing new solution offerings, tools and knowledge repositories
* People skill has worked independently on projects or as part of small consulting teams
* Should be self-driven and organized person with ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high pressure environment
* Should have experience in pursuit teams including conceptualizing propositions and presenting solutions to client
* Create expert content for point-of-view and use advanced presentation, public speaking, content creation and communication skills for C-Level discussions.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry, client or technology and function as an expert to advise senior leadership.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Strong academic background with BE/B.tech and MBA from top Tier-1 B-schools
* A background in Strategy Consulting (in top tier consulting firms), with 5+ years of relevant experience in large-scale, enterprise-wide transformations
* Min. of 5+ years of specific industry / sector experience through completed client engagements related to business transformation. Should have experience in any one or two industry sectors such as Financial services, Retail, Healthcare/Pharma, Telecom, e-commerce, etc.
* Demonstrated experience of driving business workshops as well as conducting deep-dive technology workshops to collaboratively develop transformation vision, strategy, roadmaps and blueprints
* Experience with assessing maturity of IT operating models & organizations structure to determine optimization opportunities. Should understand IT - business alignment, IT strategy and planning, development of current and future state IT architecture, roadmaps, IT/Digital maturity assessment, etc.
* Experience with large transformation related to customer experience, process re-engineering, digital, cloud, automation, AI/ML/advanced analytics, next-gen / emerging tech (IoT, blockchain, virtual twins etc).
* Conducting research and analyses of operational effectiveness, processes, stakeholders, etc., creating end-to-end visibility into how the organization executes their operations today and identifying systemic issues impacting business performance
* Should have experience in designing and managing an effective IT governance framework across the spectrum of IT service delivery
* Should be able to analyze data and translate findings into meaningful insights, integrating relevant business knowledge
* Should have knowledge about or exposure to areas such as IT Service Management and Governance, Agile methodologies, Data visualization, Cloud technologies, emerging technologies

**The following are preferred, but not required:**

* Advanced business and/or technology degrees from tier-1 schools (MBA, Masters)
* Experience in presenting directly to the C-Suite and explain complex concepts to anyone from an intern to a CFO, CHRO or CMO
* Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the strategic and improvement agenda.
* Speaking at industry conferences, round tables, and other public forums
* Authoring articles and white papers
* Business / technology innovation experience with emerging tech solutions leveraging power of combinatorial technologies AI/ML, Data Automation, Blockchain, IoT, etc
* Exposure across key technology domains is preferred (application, data, DevOps, infrastructure, cloud, network. security etc)
* Demonstrated capability to drive sales and bring a network of client relationships to the firm
* Relevant industry certification (e.g., TOGAF Biz Architect, Business Process Framework (eTOM Practitioner of TMForum), AWS Cloud Certified etc.).

**Overall Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Understanding of the current IT environment and industry IT trends to identify the engagement and client service issues.
* Ability to act as day-to-day client contact on the project engagement; run client status and other client meetings and deliver executive-level presentations that drive actions and decisions.
* Proven delivery skills including the ability to scope/size a project; staff a team with the appropriate skill set; provide subject matter direction and guidance to a team; and manage the delivery of an engagement.
* Ability to identify opportunities and help generate sell-on work during client engagements by understanding a range services and offerings and coordinating with personnel in other service lines to help sell integrated solutions that meet client needs.
* Experience in creating points of view on relevant industry trends, solutions, methodologies, and analytical frameworks and tools to bring strategic perspectives to existing solutions.
* Experience in managing a portfolio of executive level clients and developing long-term trusted advisor relationships.
* Experience in building strong teams with a solid understanding of project management, industry content knowledge, and effective client communications.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Business Development & Marketing Associate
description:
**About Flora Carbon AI**

Flora Carbon AI is a Kolkata-based climate-tech startup building an AI-powered digital MRV (dMRV) platform for nature-based carbon projects such as ARR, agroforestry and mangroves. We help project developers move from land screening to audit-ready registry documentation faster, cheaper and with higher credibility.

* **FloraScope**
  – satellite remote sensing & GIS for land eligibility, baselines and monitoring
* **Carbon Intel**
  – AI-assisted drafting of PDDs and monitoring reports
* **Pre-Audit**
  – catch gaps before the auditor does, so validation and verification don't get stuck

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Business Development & Marketing Associate to take our dMRV platform to market. You'll own the journey from first touch to closed deal – finding the right customers, building our brand in the carbon market, and turning interest into paying clients. You'll work directly with the founder and have real ownership from day one.

**What You'll Do**

*Sales & Business Development*

* Identify and prospect customers: carbon project developers, NGOs/FPOs, agroforestry and plantation companies, corporates with nature-based climate commitments, and carbon consultants
* Run outbound outreach (LinkedIn, email, calls) and book discovery meetings
* Deliver product demos and tailor pitches to project types and standards (Verra VCS, Gold Standard, etc.)
* Manage the CRM pipeline, follow-ups, proposals and pilot onboarding
* Build partnerships with validation/verification bodies (VVBs), consultants and ecosystem players

*Marketing*

* Plan and run LinkedIn-led content: posts, carousels, case studies and product updates
* Create sales collateral: pitch decks, one-pagers, brochures and email campaigns
* Support website content, SEO and newsletters
* Organise webinars and represent Flora Carbon AI at climate and carbon market events

*Market Intelligence*

* Track carbon market trends, methodology updates and competitor activity
* Bring customer feedback back to the product team to shape the roadmap

**Who You Are**

* 1–3 years of experience in B2B sales, business development or marketing (SaaS, climate-tech, sustainability or agritech preferred)
* Excellent written and spoken English; Bengali and/or Hindi is a plus
* Comfortable with cold outreach and confident presenting to senior stakeholders
* Basic understanding of carbon markets, nature-based solutions or ESG – or a strong drive to learn fast
* Hands-on with LinkedIn, CRM tools, Canva and AI tools for content
* Self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving startup

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to carbon credit projects, MRV, GIS/remote sensing or sustainability reporting
* An existing network among project developers, NGOs or forestry/agri organisations
* Degree in business, environmental science, forestry, agriculture or a related field

**Why Join Us**

* Work at the intersection of AI, remote sensing and climate action
* Direct mentorship from the founder and a real say in our go-to-market strategy
* Steep learning curve across sales, marketing and the carbon market
* Location: Kolkata (on-site)

title: Senior Manager/ Associate Director - Revenue | Kolkata
description:
As a Senior Manager/Associate Director - Revenue within our autonomous, geography-focused business unit, you will serve as a primary engine of execution and revenue generation. We do not look for traditional executors; we seek
**Growth Architects**
—professionals who view regional business, platform operations, and marketing through the lens of data, engineering, and first-principles thinking.
  
  
Operating within a fast-paced, high-velocity pod, you will collaborate cross-functionally to manage localized funnels, scale performance metrics, and optimize platform health to hit aggressive top-line and bottom-line targets.
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
To deliver robust top-line growth and bottom-line margins through disciplined platform execution, targeted audience engagement, data-driven optimization, and tight cross-functional coordination. You will treat your functional domain as a system to be architected, tested, and scaled.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* First-Principles Growth & Execution
* Deconstruct complex performance funnels into measurable variables, managing full-funnel activation from new user acquisition to repeat engagement.
* Plan, execute, and scale on-app propositions, digital marketing campaigns, and sale event constructs end-to-end with absolute precision.
* Optimize live performance daily, utilizing conversion, traffic, and margin signals to make real-time programmatic adjustments.
* Commercial, Pricing & P&L Alignment
* Monitor performance metrics and financial margins across various categories to ensure regional growth is both competitive and accretive to the P&L.
* Liaise with central product, brand, and buying teams to negotiate optimal commercial terms, funding constructs, and localized SKU assortments.
* Strategically promote high-margin initiatives or products to systematically elevate the overall geography contribution profile.
* Data Modeling, Analytics & Platform Health
* Own end-to-end tracking of critical performance trends, identifying user cohort trends and operational gaps.
* Translate localized consumer and market analytics into actionable assortment, campaign targeting, and activation decisions.
* Maintain a strict focus on system stability, aggressively flagging and fixing operational gaps, pricing mismatches, or delivery supply risks.
* Experimentation & Supply Operations
* Design and execute high-velocity A/B tests or activation changes with statistical rigor, ensuring every modification is heavily data-backed.
* Coordinate meticulously with supply chain and internal teams to establish complete sync between live demand triggers and asset availability.
* Manage a structured activation and marketing calendar that flows seamlessly alongside macro events and business priorities.

**What We Are Looking For**
**Academic Pedigree**

* B.Tech / B.E. from IIT or other Tier-1 engineering institutes, or an equivalent heavily quantitative/analytical background.

**Experience & Competencies**

* Experience:4–8 years of professional experience in high-growth environments like e-commerce, quick commerce, consumer-tech, or data/business analytics.
* The Engineer Mindset:Intensely logical and structured. You possess a natural curiosity to understand the "under-the-hood" mechanics of any platform, funnel, or user cohort.
* Technical Savvy:Highly proficient in Excel/Google Sheets with exposure to SQL, BI data visualization tools (Tableau/Looker), or automation workflows.
* Cross-Functional Fluency:Demonstrated comfort and maturity in driving cross-functional alignments with brand, supply chain, and central product environments.
* Ownership & Grit:You have the zeal to build robust processes from absolute zero and the execution resilience required to thrive in a high-velocity, concurrent work environment.

**Good to Have**

* Prior regional, hyperlocal, or category management experience within quick commerce, marketplace, or hyper-growth consumer apps.
* Familiarity with app CMS platforms, digital promotion engines, or inventory optimization systems.

**The Perks**

* Direct Impact:You aren’t just running campaigns or updating a dashboard; you are actively engineering the growth engine of an autonomous business unit.
* Intellectual Autonomy:We foster a high-trust, fast-paced environment where hierarchy takes a backseat—data and logical arguments always win.

**About Company**
Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
  
  
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
  
  
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
  
  
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.

title: DIGITAL MARKETING & LEAD GENERATION EXECUTIVE
description:
**Company Description** 
 Journey Partner, founded in November 2021, is a travel solutions provider serving clients across India and internationally for tours, travel, and MICE requirements. The company has organized domestic travel across diverse regions of India, including Jammu \& Kashmir, Rajasthan, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Andaman \& Nicobar Islands, Eastern and North Eastern states, and Gujarat. Internationally, Journey Partner has supported travel to destinations in South East Asia, the Middle East, Europe, the USA, and Africa. Countries frequently served include Japan, Singapore, Vietnam, Malaysia, Thailand, Cambodia, Sri Lanka, Maldives, Bhutan, UAE, Türkiye, Russia, Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Greece, France, the UK, USA, Italy, and Kenya. The organization focuses on delivering reliable, tailored travel experiences for a wide range of customer needs.
   

  

**Role Objective**
 To drive Journey Partner’s digital growth by improving online visibility, generating qualified business leads and strengthening engagement across search engines, social media, website and other digital channels.
   

  

 The role will have end\-to\-end responsibility for digital marketing activities, with a strong emphasis on measurable lead generation and conversion
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 \*\*1\. Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)\*\*
   

  

 \* Develop and execute on\-page, off\-page and technical SEO initiatives.
   

 \* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis and search trend analysis.
   

 \* Improve organic ranking for relevant travel, holiday, corporate travel and MICE\-related searches.
   

 \* Optimise website pages, blogs, destination content and landing pages.
   

 \* Monitor performance through Google Search Console, GA4 and appropriate SEO tools.
   

  

 \*\*2\. Lead Generation \& Performance Marketing\*\*
   

  

 \* Plan and execute digital campaigns for generating qualified enquiries.
   

 \* Generate leads for domestic and international holidays, corporate travel, MICE and other Journey Partner services.
   

 \* Design campaign funnels and landing pages to improve conversion.
   

 \* Track leads from source through enquiry and conversion.
   

 \* Continuously improve cost per lead and quality of leads.
   

  

 \*\*3\. Google Ads\*\*
   

  

 \* Independently plan and manage Google Search, Display, remarketing and other relevant campaigns.
   

 \* Undertake keyword planning, audience targeting, bidding and budget optimisation.
   

 \* Monitor CPC, CTR, conversion rate, CPL and ROI.
   

 \* Optimise campaigns based on actual business results.
   

  

 \*\*4\. Social Media \& Meta Marketing\*\*
   

  

 \* Manage Journey Partner’s presence across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube and other relevant platforms.
   

 \* Plan and execute Meta advertising campaigns.
   

 \* Develop monthly social media and campaign calendars.
   

 \* Increase meaningful reach, engagement, enquiries and conversions.
   

  

 \*\*5\. Digital Content Creation\*\*
   

  

 \* Create engaging destination content, promotional posts, reels, short videos, campaign creatives and advertisements.
   

 \* Develop digital content around customer experiences, destinations, offers, festivals and travel trends.
   

 \* Prepare SEO\-friendly website and blog content.
   

 \* Coordinate photography/video/content requirements wherever necessary.
   

  

 \*\*6\. Website \& Digital Presence\*\*
   

  

 \* Regularly review and update website content, packages, offers and landing pages.
   

 \* Improve website user journey and calls\-to\-action.
   

 \* Work towards increasing organic traffic, enquiries and conversion.
   

 \* Coordinate with website/technical service providers where specialist intervention is required.
   

  

 \*\*7\. Analytics \& Performance Reporting\*\*
   

  

 \* Monitor GA4, Google Search Console, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager and social\-media analytics.
   

 \* Prepare monthly digital performance dashboards.
   

 \* Analyse source\-wise leads and conversions.
   

 \* Recommend corrective actions based on data and campaign performance.
   

  

 \#\#\# Key Performance Indicators
   

  

 Performance will primarily be evaluated through:
   

  

 \* Qualified leads generated
   

 \* Cost per qualified lead
   

 \* Lead\-to\-conversion ratio
   

 \* Revenue generated from digital leads
   

 \* Return on advertising spend
   

 \* Organic search growth and keyword rankings
   

 \* Website traffic and enquiry conversion
   

 \* Social\-media reach and engagement
   

 \* Growth in direct and organic enquiries
   

  

 \#\#\# Candidate Profile
   

  

 The candidate should have:
   

  

 \* 2–4 years of hands\-on digital marketing experience.
   

 \* Demonstrable experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads.
   

 \* Practical knowledge of SEO and Google Search Console.
   

 \* Experience in lead\-generation campaigns.
   

 \* Working knowledge of GA4 and conversion tracking.
   

 \* Ability to independently create digital content and campaign concepts.
   

 \* Working knowledge of Canva or similar design tools.
   

 \* Basic reel/video editing capability.
   

 \* Strong analytical and communication skills.
   

  

 Experience in travel, tourism, hospitality or another B2C/B2B service industry will be preferred.
   

  

 Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate actual campaigns handled and measurable results achieved during the selection process.
   

  

  

 The candidate should be capable of independently planning and executing campaigns—not merely coordinating with external agencies.
   

  

 What Success Will Look Like
   

  

 The role will be measured not simply by followers, likes or website traffic, but by:
   

  

 Organic Search Growth \| Qualified Leads \| Cost per Lead \| Lead\-to\-Conversion Ratio \| Website Enquiries \| Campaign ROI \| Digital Revenue Contribution

At Vehere, you’ll work with talented people, take on meaningful challenges, and have the opportunity to make a real impact. We value curiosity, ownership, collaboration, and the drive to keep growing.
 



 If you’re ready to learn, contribute, and grow with a team that’s building for the future, we’d love to have you on board.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




  





 International Channel Account Manager will be responsible for expanding Vehere’s global channel ecosystem, building and managing strategic partnerships across international markets, and driving revenue growth through effective partner engagement. This role requires a strong understanding of global channel dynamics, cross\-cultural business practices, and the ability to execute sales strategies that scale internationally
 



  





**Key Roles and Responsibilities:** 




**1\.Expand Global Channel Base** 



* Identify, recruit, and onboard new international partners, distributors, and system integrators to strengthen Vehere’s global footprint.
* Develop go\-to\-market strategies tailored to regional markets, ensuring alignment with Vehere’s global objectives
* Coordinate technical specialists and resources to address customer requirements in multi\-country, complex selling situations.



  





**2\. Partner Relationship Management** 



* Cultivate strong consultative relationships with key stakeholders across diverse geographies, acting as the single point of contact for partner satisfaction.



**3\.Revenue Growth:** 



* Drive attainment of international sales revenue and margin targets, while tracking and improving partner productivity metrics.
* Deliver product and solution presentations to international partners and prospective customers, adapting messaging to local market needs.
* Provide accurate international sales forecasts based on channel prospects and market intelligence.
* Offer insights to Product Management on global competitive activity, pricing trends, and emerging technologies.
* Adhere to high quality work standards.
* Responsible for maintaining Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability of Vehere’s information assets including business critical information.



  





**Skills and Experience:** 



* Bachelor’s degree; preferably in business, computer science, marketing, or engineering
* 5\-7 years in technical software sales; preferably cyber security, channels \& enterprise software and/or related consulting services
* Proven track record of
 **expanding channel ecosystems across multiple regions** 
 and consistently exceeding sales quotas.
* Deep knowledge of global vendor business models and financial metrics for successful software operations.
* Strong IT channel sales program management experience with international exposure.
* Ability to navigate cross\-cultural business environments and adapt strategies accordingly.
* Excellent negotiation, commercial acumen, and business judgment in diverse international contexts.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to manage change effectively.
* Energetic, persuasive, and well\-organized, with a willingness to travel extensively.

title: ASM/SR ASM
description:
**We Are The People Who Give Possibilities Purpose**
 BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Summary:\*\*
   

  

 We are seeking an Area Sales Manager (ASM) or Senior Area Sales Manager (SR ASM) to drive sales and market share growth within a designated territory for Becton Dickinson India Private Limited. This role involves developing and executing sales strategies, managing customer relationships, and leading a team to achieve ambitious targets.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities:\*\*
   

  

* Achieve and exceed assigned sales targets and key performance indicators (KPIs) for the territory.
* Develop and implement strategic sales plans to expand market share and penetrate new accounts.
* Manage and nurture relationships with key customers, including hospitals, laboratories, and healthcare professionals.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities, collaborating with marketing and product teams.
* Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of sales representatives (if applicable to SR ASM role), fostering a high\-performance sales culture.
* Conduct regular market analysis, competitor monitoring, and provide feedback to management on market trends and customer needs.
* Ensure timely and accurate sales forecasting, reporting, and pipeline management.
* Participate in product launches, sales meetings, and professional development programs.
* Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and ethical guidelines.
* Manage territory budget and resources effectively.


 Job Qualifications:\*\*
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Business Administration). Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum of 5\-8 years of progressive sales experience in the medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or healthcare industry, with at least 2\-3 years in a managerial or leadership role for SR ASM.
* Proven track record of consistently achieving or exceeding sales targets.
* Strong understanding of the Indian healthcare market and its dynamics.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships.
* Demonstrated leadership and team management capabilities (for SR ASM).
* Proficiency in CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.


 Why Join Us?
   

  

 To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive.
   

  

 We believe that when people connect in person, we learn faster, collaborate more deeply, and build a stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face\-to\-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success.
   

  

**To learn more about BD visit** 
 https://bd.com/careers.

title: Co Founder & CEO l Food Health & Wellness Ecosystems l Startup
description:
**NutriGets is Looking for a Co\-founder \& CEO (→ 1 Builder) \| Kolkata**
**Review the full job details and screening questions before applying. If anything doesn't work for you, kindly hold off on applying.**
**Location:** 
 Kolkata (on\-ground involvement required).
   

**Type:** 
 Full\-Time, Founding Leadership Role.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 This is NOT a typical CEO role. As Co\-Founder \& CEO, you will be the strategic and operational leader responsible for shaping and driving the organization forward. This role demands a passionate entrepreneur who thrives in startup environments, takes ownership end\-to\-end, and is eager to build something meaningful from the ground up.
   

  

 This is a full\-time, onsite role in Kolkata, not an advisory position. You will work closely with co\-founders and stakeholders to translate vision into impact.
   

  

**Who can avoid**
 \* People looking for a structured corporate role.
   

 \* Strategy only professionals.
   

 \* Those expecting high fixed salaries from Day one.
   

 \* This is a full\-time, onsite role in Kolkata.
   

 \* We are looking for a true co\-founder, not an employee with a title.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Vision, Strategy \& Roadmap:
   

 ✳️ Define and execute the company’s long\-term vision across multiple verticals including technology platforms, consumer products, and supply\-chain driven businesses.
   

 ✳️ Design a phased expansion strategy — prioritizing focus, validation, and scalability at each stage.
   

 ✳️ Balance short\-term execution with long\-term ecosystem building.
   

  

**Business Building \& Execution**
 ✳️ Lead the company from idea stage to launch, growth, and expansion.
   

 ✳️ Own the development of business models, revenue strategies, pricing, and unit economics across verticals.
   

 ✳️ Ensure strong execution discipline while operating in high\-ambiguity environments.
   

  

**Operations \& Cross\-Functional Leadership**
 ✳️ Build and manage operations across technology, product, marketing, supply chain, partnerships, and customer experience.
   

 ✳️ Establish systems, SOPs, compliance frameworks, and performance metrics.
   

 ✳️ Oversee execution across both digital platforms and physical operations as the company evolves.
   

  

**Fundraising \& Financial Leadership**
 ✳️ Lead fundraising strategy across seed, pre\-Series, and future rounds.
   

 ✳️ Manage investor relationships, board communication, and stakeholder alignment.
   

 ✳️ Own financial planning, capital allocation, cost control, and long\-term sustainability.
   

  

**Team Building \& Culture**
 ✳️ Build a strong founding team and leadership pipeline.
   

 ✳️ Recruit senior leaders as new verticals are launched.
   

 ✳️ Create a culture of ownership, accountability, speed, and ethical business practices.
   

  

**Brand, Partnerships \& External Leadership**
 ✳️ Act as the public face of the company with investors, partners, regulators, and media.
   

 ✳️ Build strategic partnerships across healthcare, wellness, FMCG, agriculture, and technology ecosystems.
   

 ✳️ Drive trust, credibility, and long\-term brand equity.
   

**Who You Are**
 ✳️ Someone who has worked in/with startups (FoodTech, D2C, B2B, Ops\-heavy models)
   

 ✳️ A builder who enjoys execution more than just strategy
   

 ✳️ Comfortable working in uncertainty and solving real\-world problems daily
   

 ✳️ Obsessed with growth, numbers, and getting things done.
   

 ✳️ Launch and run the first operational unit.
   

 ✳️ Build the business from 0 → ₹50 lakhs/month.
   

 ✳️ Handle execution, investors, operations, growth, and team building, etc.
   

 ✳️ Create a scalable model for expansion.
   

 ✳️ Minimum 5\+ years of leadership experience across startups, scale\-ups, or complex businesses.
   

 ✳️ Proven track record of building and scaling businesses from early stages.
   

 ✳️ Experience working across Food / Consumer ✳️ Brands, HealthTech \& FMCG or Consumer Goods.
   

 ✳️ Demonstrated experience in P\&L ownership, fundraising, and team leadership.
   

  

**Strategic \& Execution Skills**
 ✳️ Strong ability to think long\-term while executing relentlessly in the present.
   

 ✳️ Deep understanding of consumer behavior, operational complexity, and scalability.
   

 ✳️ Comfort navigating regulated or semi\-regulated sectors.
   

 ✳️ Ability to prioritize focus while planning for future vertical expansion.
   

  

**Leadership Traits**
 ✳️ Founder mindset with extreme ownership.
   

 ✳️ High resilience, adaptability, and decision\-making confidence.
   

 ✳️ Strong ethical compass and commitment to building trusted brands.
   

 ✳️ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
   

 ✳️ Experience launching or managing multi\-business or multi\-brand organizations.
   

 ✳️ Exposure to digital health, FoodTech , wellness platforms.
   

 ✳️ Experience working with institutional investors or venture capital.
   

  

**Why This Role Is Unique
   

 ✅** 
 Opportunity to co\-found and lead a multi\-vertical ecosystem, not just a single startup.
   

 ✅ Permanent equity ownership in a long\-term vision.
   

 ✅ Ability to shape strategy, culture, and impact from day one.
   

 ✅ Build businesses that intersect technology, health, sustainability, and consumer trust.
   

 ✅ Long\-term wealth creation opportunity.

+ Experience


*

description:
**Department** 
 : Rare Disease \& Public Care
   

  

**Location** 
 : Kolkata
   

  

**Company: Novo Nordisk India Pvt. Ltd**
**Your impact begins here**
 As Market Access Manager, you will strengthen how Novo Nordisk engages payers, shapes therapy access and manages key accounts across your market. You will connect commercial strategy with market access execution — identifying external opportunities, building account\-based plans and helping secure formulary presence for our portfolio. By bringing together insight, cross\-functional collaboration and practical action, you will help ensure that more people living with serious chronic diseases can access the treatments they need. Your impact starts today.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
* A Master's degree, preferably within a quantitative or management discipline, from a well\-recognised institute.
* 5\+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Direct experience in at least two of the following areas: Pricing, Outcomes Research, Health Economics, Brand Value Communications, Advocacy Development, Payer Engagement, Market Access, Customer Insight Gathering, Customer Value Proposition Development, or Negotiation and Business Acquisition.
* Experience building relationships and networks with healthcare decision\-makers, including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders.
* A track record of delivering business objectives in alignment with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* The ability to analyse complex issues, apply strategic thinking and implement tactical plans.
* Experience articulating complex market access topics clearly and persuasively to key decision\-makers.
* Commercial, business or medical experience at a managerial level, with the ability to work effectively within cross\-functional teams.


**Useful, But Not Essential**
* Exposure to areas beyond your direct experience listed above.


**What You'll Do**
* Shape therapy access strategies for new and existing launches by identifying market opportunities, planning account\-based approaches and ensuring budget allocation for Novo Nordisk therapy areas.
* Manage national key accounts — including ESI, Railway, CGHS and Army — driving aligned actions across commercial functions to strengthen product presence and formulary inclusion.
* Coordinate with Sales Managers and Key Account Managers on state tenders, tracking product cycles across institutional accounts and providing regular updates on tender and account status.
* Train and support Key Account Managers on account management practices, collaborating with Sales, Marketing and People \& Organisation to build capability.
* Serve as the single point of contact for therapy access knowledge, connecting global materials and up\-to\-date product information with local teams and institutional partners.
* Support the institution team in filing tenders by providing accurate, current documentation and product information.


**Who You'll Work With**
 You will join a market access team within Rare Disease \& Public Care, working at the intersection of commercial strategy and payer engagement. Your closest partners will be colleagues across Marketing, CMR, Sales, Key Account Management and medical functions within the affiliate.
   

  

 Externally, you will build and maintain a broad network of stakeholders with influence on market access outcomes — including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders. You will also connect with regional and global market access colleagues to share learning and align on priorities.
   

  

 The role is cross\-functional by nature. You will bring different perspectives together, create clarity around account priorities and help teams move from insight to action across therapy areas.
   

  

**What You Can Expect Here**
 You will work in an environment where your expertise in payer engagement and account strategy directly shapes commercial outcomes. The role offers the opportunity to deepen your market access skills, collaborate across functions and contribute to work that expands treatment access for people living with serious chronic diseases.
   

  

 You will be trusted to take ownership of your accounts and priorities, supported to develop new capabilities and encouraged to share your perspective. Cross\-functional collaboration, honest feedback and a focus on results define how the team works together.
   

  

**Start now**
 Your impact begins today. If you are ready to strengthen therapy access and help more people benefit from Novo Nordisk's portfolio, apply for the Market Access Manager role by 24 September 2026\. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
   

  

 We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

description:
**SRMB STEEL \| JOB DESCRIPTION.** 




**Regional Vice President.**

 SRMB STEEL.

 President and Chief Sales \& Marketing Officer.

 **15 to 20 years in steel Industry, from Tier 1 or Tier 2 brands only.** 




  





 SRMB Group is one of India’s respected steel and construction\-materials companies, with a turnover of over ₹2,500 crore, 3,000\+ employees and a strong manufacturing base.
 



 We are looking for an experienced
 **Regional Vice President.** 




  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Own the regional P\&L. Deliver volume, contribution margin and counter share for the region under the national framework.
* Lead the Zonal Head. Set targets for 3 to 4 Zonal Heads, run the review cadence, and build a 60\-plus team that performs.
* Drive district and counter execution. Take share at the counter through disciplined district plans, reach and range, not through price wars.
* Manage cost and productivity. Hold fixed cost and team productivity to plan, so the region grows profitably as it scales.
* Lead the West Bengal model (East \& NE). For East \& NE, drive the 2X West Bengal play through the two Bengal Zonal Heads and make it the template other regions follow.
* Develop the market and the team. Grow the channel, the counters and the next line of leaders across the region.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* **15 to 20 years** 
 from
 **Tier 1 or Tier 2 brands only** 
 .
* MBA preferred across all regions.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Must have led a team of at least 60, with 3 to 4 direct reports at Zonal Head level.
* Proven regional P\&L ownership, with growth delivered on contribution margin, not tonnage alone.
* Deep command of district and counter\-level execution and counter\-share gain.
* A leader who builds teams and the next line of leaders, and runs on data and a clear review cadence.
* For East \& NE, a strong track record in the eastern market and the ability to drive the West Bengal 2X model.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Experience operating under a unified national market framework.
* Experience in managing multiple regions or diverse state markets.



  





**Pay range and compensation package** 




  





 As per the Industry.
 



  





**Additional Role Context** 




  





*Why this role exists* 



* The Regional VP runs a region of steel sales end to end: the P\&L, the Zonal Heads, and the district and counter execution that turns strategy into share.
* All four regions run under one national market framework, so growth is comparable, disciplined and margin\-led rather than a set of local styles.



  





*The national market framework (one scope)* 



* Every region operates on the same three pillars, under one scope.
* Contribution margin. Growth is measured by contribution, not tonnage alone. The region is run to protect and grow margin.
* Fixed\-cost and team productivity. Output per member and return on fixed cost are managed as hard numbers, so the region scales efficiently.
* Counter share. Share of the counter, won district by district, is the true measure of market strength.
* East \& NE leads the model. West Bengal must lead the framework, targeting 2X sales growth and competitive dominance through rigorous district and counter\-level execution, with two dedicated Zonal Heads for North Bengal and South Bengal.



  





*Regional scope* 




  




* Region / Indicative states / Special mandate.
* East \& NE: West Bengal, Odisha, Bihar, Jharkhand, Assam and the North East, Sikkim – Lead the model: West Bengal 2X, two ZHs for North and South Bengal.



  





*Measurable indices and scale of growth* 




  




* Targets are indicative and to be locked per region with the CSMO..
* Index / What it measures / Target .
* Volume growth – Regional steel tonnage – \+25 to 35% YoY (WB: 2X).
* Contribution margin – Region contribution and margin – Grow margin YoY under one framework.
* Counter share – Share of counter throughput – Top 2 or 3 in priority districts.
* Reach – Active billing counters – Rising quarter on quarter.
* Team productivity – Tonnage and contribution per member – Improve YoY, fixed cost held.
* Collections – DSO and overdue share – Within norm, overdue under 5%.

title: FREELANCE AI GROWTH & PERFORMANCE MARKETING STRATEGIST - Part-Time | Remote | Property/Real Estate + Global Affiliate Marketing
description:
**Can you transform advertising into both MARKET RESEARCH and REVENUE?** 




**We are looking for a creative, strategic and hands\-on AI Growth \& Performance Marketing Strategist to work with us on a part\-time freelance/consulting basis across two business initiatives:** 




  





**🏠 PROPERTY / REAL ESTATE BUSINESS** 




**Develop innovative, low\-cost and highly engaging advertising systems for promoting land/properties, identifying genuine buyer audiences and generating qualified enquiries.** 




  





**🌎 GLOBAL AFFILIATE MARKETING BUSINESS** 




**Build a scalable, AI\-assisted affiliate marketing system targeting international markets with high\-intent audiences, suitable offers and profitable economics.** 









**🔥 THIS IS NOT A ROUTINE DIGITAL MARKETING ROLE** 




**We are NOT looking for someone who only:** 




**• Runs Facebook Ads** 




**• Boosts posts** 




**• Designs graphics** 




**• Posts social media content** 




**• Writes generic ad copy** 




**• Generates traffic** 




  





**We need someone who can:** 




**Research → Create → Advertise → Test → Analyse → Learn → Optimise → Convert** 




**The complete growth cycle should include:** 




**Market Research → Audience Identification → Consumer Insights → Media Planning → Creative Advertising → AI\-Assisted Creative Production → Campaign Distribution → Engagement → Lead Generation → Conversion → Data Analysis → Optimization → Scaling** 




**The objective is to build a repeatable AI\-assisted growth engine, not isolated campaigns.** 









**🎯 CREATIVE ADVERTISING — CORE RESPONSIBILITY** 




**You must be capable of creating highly attractive, attention\-grabbing, curiosity\-driven and response\-oriented advertisements.** 




**The objective:** 




**STOP → ATTRACT → CREATE CURIOSITY → ENGAGE → GENERATE RESPONSE → DISCOVER INSIGHTS → GENERATE LEADS → CONVERT**

**• Strong hooks and headlines** 




**• Curiosity/problem\-solution advertisements**

**• Poll/quiz\-based campaigns** 




**• Comparison and educational ads** 




**• Story\-based and opportunity\-driven ads** 




**• Trust/risk\-reduction ads** 




**• UGC/testimonial concepts** 




**• Static, carousel and video creatives** 




**• AI\-generated video/AI\-avatar creatives** 




**• Lead\-generation and retargeting advertisements** 




**• Direct\-response campaigns** 




**We need creative strategy, not merely design capability.** 









**🧠 ADVERTISING AS MARKET RESEARCH** 




**A key requirement is using advertisements to discover actual consumer demand.** 




**Example:** 




**Instead of:** 




**“LAND FOR SALE — CONTACT US”** 




**we may test:** 




**“What is stopping you from buying a plot right now?”** 




**A. Price** 




**B. Location** 




**C. Legal/documentation** 




**D. Financing** 




**E. Unsure where to invest** 




**F. Waiting for the right opportunity**

**• Consumer pain points** 




**• Buying motivations** 




**• Objections** 




**• Preferences** 




**• Price sensitivity** 




**• Consumer language** 




**• High\-intent audiences** 




**and convert those insights into better advertisements.** 




**This methodology should also be applied to affiliate marketing.** 









**📊 MEDIA PLANNING \& CHANNEL STRATEGY** 




**Media planning is a core responsibility.** 




**You should determine:** 




**WHO is the audience** 




**→ WHERE they can be reached** 




**→ WHAT message should be shown** 




**→ WHICH CHANNEL should be used** 




**→ WHAT BUDGET is required** 




**→ HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED**

**🔬 CREATIVE \& MEDIA TESTING** 




**We do not want to spend heavily on one advertisement and hope it works.** 




**You should create structured experiments:** 




**Multiple Hooks × Multiple Angles × Multiple Creatives × Multiple Audiences** 




**Testing variables:** 




**• Hook** 




**• Headline** 




**• Image/video** 




**• Opening frame** 




**• Consumer pain point** 




**• Benefit** 




**• Offer** 




**• CTA** 




**• Audience** 




**• Format** 




**The objective is to identify the strongest combination of:** 




**Message \+ Creative \+ Audience \+ Channel \+ Offer**

**CTR \| CPC \| CPM \| Engagement \| Comments \| Shares \| Leads \| CPL \| Conversion Rate \| CPA \| EPC \| Revenue \| ROAS \| Profit** 




**and identify what should be tested next.** 




**The objective is to build an AI\-assisted creative experimentation and optimization system.**

**We are not interested only in traffic generation.** 




**You should understand:** 




**Impression → Click → Engagement → Lead → Landing Page → Offer → Conversion → Revenue → Profit**

title: Sr Account Manager

**Job Description**
 As a Sr Account Manager here at Honeywell, you will play a crucial role in driving the company's strategic growth and success. Your leadership and expertise in managing key accounts will enable you to build strong relationships with customers and provide innovative solutions to meet their evolving needs. By guiding and mentoring your team, you will foster a culture of excellence and drive revenue growth, positioning the company as a market leader in strategic account management.
   

  

 In this role, your impact on the company will be transformative. Your strategic vision and leadership will drive revenue growth, expand market presence, and strengthen customer relationships. By effectively managing key accounts and guiding your team, you will position the company for long\-term success and establish it as a leader in the industry.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 This exciting position will be focused on developing strong pipeline of Gas Metering ,Regulating and analysis (M\&C) business which includes Ultrasonic Meters, Flow Computers, Gas Chromatographs, Turbine Meters, RPD meters, Gas Renewable Solutions for Bio Gas and H2 etc., Regulators in growing vertical like Natural Gas, Bio Gas, Hydrogen, Oil and Gas, City Gas Distribution etc . You will develop customer relationships through coordinating and/or attending trade shows, seminar, and similar events. You will provide education of Honeywell product through technical presentations. You will maintain and provide reports and opportunity status using our customer relationship management system. You will provide competitive intelligence and market trends. You will provide forecast/demand input to Sales Inventory Operations Planning (SIOP).
   

  

 The role will coordinate and integrate an aligned customer strategy, defines product and solution scope across businesses and sets out a supporting decarbonization and growth roadmap.
   

  

 The role collaborates with sales and channel partner teams, who drive contracts, transacts, and operationally delivers with customers on the ground.
   

  

 The candidate will utilize knowledge of Gas Chromatography, Gas Renewable Market and applications, market/customer Insights, value chain understanding and risk management to develop credible and sustainable relationships At Senior Levels with Key Customers.
   

  

 The role will focus on developing multi\-year strategic customer plans and delivery roadmap, building India’s corporate customer headquarters\-level relationships, supporting annual planning cycle, leading multi\-functional and cross line of business core teams across Honeywell.
   

  

 Engage C\-suite and key decision makers at customers’ Americas headquarters during all critical stages of the strategic customer sales cycle.
   

  

 You have a deep knowledge of and passion for the energy Midstream Natural Gas Transmission market, including experience designing, structuring and selling Gas Quality and Gas Renewable projects, or other related products.
   

  

 Specification driving with consultants and EPC contractors.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop pipeline of opportunity and sales in respective assigned region
* Track the Government policy changes in renewable energy.
* Develop the strategy for H2 and Bio gas
* Attend (trade shows, seminars, events)
* Visit existing customers
* Search for new customers
* Campaign management
* Customer reporting
* Gas quality product knowledge
* Automation and remote solutions
* Customer account management
* Specification driving with consultants and EPC contractors.
* Chanel Partners handling


**Qualifications**
**Must Haves:**
* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent in Instrumentation / Mechanical
* 7\+ years of experience on selling gas measurement and quality for transmission, natural gas distributions projects
* 2\+ years of experience in Bio gas and Hydrogen market development.
* Candidate with gas solution selling in process and petrochemical industry for selling Natural gas products.


**We Value**
* MBA in business development


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

**Salary: Upto 40000/\- per Month Plus others**

title: Field Marketing Representative
description:
Field Marketing Representative
   

 Company: Mercury Educare
   

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

 Location: Kolkata
   

 Work Mode: In\-Person / Field\-Based
   

 About Mercury Educare
   

 Mercury Educare is an education and skill\-development organization focused on helping students and institutions access industry\-relevant training, AI education, vocational programs, career development initiatives, and employment\-oriented opportunities.
   

 We work with colleges, educational institutions, training institutes, industry partners, and other organizations to bring practical, career\-focused training programs directly to students and institutions.
   

 We are looking for a dynamic, confident, and target\-oriented Field Marketing Representative who can build institutional relationships, visit colleges and institutes, generate business opportunities, and close partnerships for our training programs.
   

 Job Responsibilities
   

 1\. College \& Institute Marketing
   

 Visit colleges, universities, educational institutes, and training centers across Kolkata and nearby areas.
   

 Meet with principals, directors, placement officers, department heads, training \& placement teams, and other decision\-makers.
   

 Present Mercury Educare's AI training, skill\-development programs, vocational courses, career programs, and other training solutions.
   

 Identify institutional requirements and recommend suitable training programs.
   

 2\. Business Development \& Deal Closing
   

 Generate new institutional leads through field visits, networking, referrals, events, and direct outreach.
   

 Conduct meetings and presentations with college/institute management.
   

 Negotiate and close training partnerships, workshops, seminars, certification programs, and institutional training deals.
   

 Maintain a consistent pipeline of prospective colleges and institutes.
   

 3\. Channel Partner Development
   

 Identify and onboard Channel Partners, Education Consultants, Training Partners, and Local Representatives.
   

 Build long\-term relationships with channel partners for student and institutional lead generation.
   

 Develop new business opportunities through the partner network.
   

 Achieve channel\-partner acquisition and revenue targets.
   

 4\. Student \& Institutional Engagement
   

 Organize and coordinate seminars, workshops, career awareness sessions, AI awareness programs, and training events in colleges and institutes.
   

 Explain program benefits, career opportunities, certifications, and employment relevance to students and institutional stakeholders.
   

 Support student mobilization and enrollment wherever required.
   

 5\. Relationship Management
   

 Develop strong relationships with colleges, institutes, placement cells, faculty members, management teams, and channel partners.
   

 Regularly follow up with prospects and existing partners.
   

 Maintain long\-term institutional relationships to generate repeat business and referrals.
   

 6\. Reporting \& Target Achievement
   

 Maintain records of field visits, meetings, leads, proposals, follow\-ups, partnerships, and closures.
   

 Submit regular sales and activity reports.
   

 Consistently work toward monthly lead\-generation, partnership, and revenue targets.
   

 Desired Candidate Profile
   

 Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
   

 0–3 years of experience in field marketing, business development, education sales, institutional sales, admissions, training sales, or a related field.
   

 Freshers with excellent communication, confidence, and sales ability may also apply.
   

 Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
   

 Comfortable visiting colleges and institutes on a regular basis.
   

 Should be confident in meeting senior institutional decision\-makers.
   

 Ability to generate leads independently and convert prospects into business partnerships.
   

 Target\-oriented and willing to work in a field\-sales environment.
   

 Knowledge of MS Office, Google Sheets, CRM/reporting tools is an advantage.
   

 Candidates with existing networks in colleges, institutes, education consultancies, or training organizations will be preferred.
   

 What We Offer
   

 Opportunity to work in the growing AI, Education \& Skill Development sector.
   

 Exposure to institutional sales and B2B business development.
   

 Opportunity to build a strong professional network across colleges and educational institutions.
   

 Career growth and performance\-based incentives.
   

 Dynamic and growth\-oriented work environment.
   

 Opportunity to contribute to expanding access to AI and industry\-relevant training for students.
   

 Who We Are Looking For
   

 We are looking for someone who is not limited to generating leads but can take ownership of the complete business\-development cycle:
   

 College Visit → Decision\-Maker Meeting → Presentation → Follow\-up → Negotiation → Partnership → Deal Closure
   

 If you are confident, energetic, comfortable with fieldwork, and enjoy meeting people, building relationships, and closing deals, this role is for you.
   

 Join Mercury Educare and help us build partnerships with educational institutions while creating new opportunities for students through AI and skill\-based training.

title: MS-Microsoft Business Applications Lead-Executive Director
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Job Name\- GDS Consulting \- Microsoft Business Applications Leader \- GTM, Delivery and Alliance Management**
**Position Summary**
 Microsoft Alliance is part of EY's broader strategy to work with leading technology providers to deliver innovative solutions that help clients navigate the complexities of the digital world. Through such alliances, consulting is better equipped to support clients in achieving their strategic objectives and driving digital success. Microsoft Business Applications practice at GDS focuses on leveraging Microsoft's suite of business applications to help clients optimize their operations and transform their businesses.
   

  

 To strengthen our capability and brand, the following are the underpinning aspects
   

  

* A world class global delivery capability on Microsoft Business Applications with focus on FS \& non FS segments in areas – Americas,
* EMEIA and APAC
* The ability for GDS to own and drive strategic initiatives by playing an active role in various Fields of play for both G\-360 \& Core Accounts For FY 25 and beyond, Microsoft Business Application (Biz Apps) is seeing huge potential across domains like Finance, Risk, Supply Chain, HR and across both Financial \& Commercial Sectors. The long\-term goal is to expand its footprint in not just having capability but having significant presence in Sector Solutions and Field of Play offerings of EY. Microsoft Biz Apps Leader is needed at GDS to provide vision, drive growth, maintain excellence in delivery, and ensure that clients receive the best possible solutions to their business challenges using Microsoft technologies.


 GDS Microsoft Biz Apps Leader will have responsibilities across following key focus areas,
   

  

* Leadership \& Strategy
+ Define and execute a comprehensive strategy for Microsoft Business Applications, aligning with overall business goals and market opportunities.
+ Lead and mentor teams responsible for delivery, pre\-sales, and solution architecture within the Microsoft Business Applications domain.
+ Drive organizational growth by leveraging Microsoft Business Apps as a core strategic pillar.

* Go\-To\-Market (GTM) Management
+ Develop and manage the GTM strategy for Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and other Microsoft Business Apps, focusing on key growth opportunities.
+ Partner global and regional Microsoft Biz Apps champion to win large engagements from current deal $225 MN in FY 25 to $375 MN by FY 28 with YoY growth of 18%.
+ Collaborate with other partner firms within EY and establish value propositions and solutions that resonate with target clients.
+ Engage with clients to evangelize Microsoft Business Apps and address critical business needs.
+ Engage with Microsoft alliance partners to drive growth

* Delivery Management
+ Oversee the successful delivery of projects
+ Expand the GTM and Delivery team with mix of Associate Directors, Senior Manager, Managers and below with target team size of 650 by FY 28
+ Applications projects, ensuring timely execution, high quality, and client satisfaction.
+ Establish best practices for project delivery, including process improvements, risk management, and quality assurance.
+ Work closely with technical teams to ensure alignment with delivery goals and client requirements.

* Alliance \& Partnership Management
+ Act as the primary liaison between EY and Microsoft, nurturing the alliance to maximize mutual benefits.
+ Identify opportunities for co\-selling, joint initiatives, and strategic investments with Microsoft.
+ Maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across Microsoft and other relevant partners to enhance partnership performance.

* Technology Expertise
+ Demonstrate an in\-depth understanding of Microsoft Business Applications, including Dynamics 365 (Sales, Finance, Supply Chain), Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Automate), and Azure.
+ Stay up to date with new features, releases, and advancements in the Microsoft ecosystem and communicate these insights effectively to both internal and external stakeholders.

* Business Growth \& Innovation
+ Leverage your industry exp


**Essential Functions Of The Job**
* Leadership and team management, including talent acquisition, development, and retention
* Works with EY teams to ensure One Microsoft approach
* Develop and manage the GTM strategy for Microsoft Dynamics 365,
* Power Platform, and other Microsoft Business Apps, focusing on key growth opportunities.
* Technical oversight and quality assurance of deliverables
* Standardizes, simplifies, and modernizes the delivery practices
* Business development and client relationship management
* Financial management of the practice's operations


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities**
* Professional with the ability to make most of the decisions pertaining to practice growth, investment in new areas of technology and people issues
* Defining location strategy with respect to global locations, building integrated operating model, identifying right pricing, and acquiring local talent
* Sharp focus on building competitive cost of delivery
* Defining winning themes and building differentiated solutions


**Education \& Experience**
* Minimum of bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems Management, or a related field with 20 years of experience. Graduate from top colleges is a huge plus
* Microsoft certifications in Dynamics 365 and Power Platforms with technical delivery experience in Dynamics 365 CRM App, PowerApps,
* Power platform, Front and Back\-office integrations, Microsoft Azure DevOps.
* Experience of managing practice/accounts with HC above 200\+ would be a huge plus
* Demonstrated record in driving revenue within existing clients and in developing new prospects at the “C” level of Fortune 500 companies
* Demonstrated ability to work successfully within a matrixed organization and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering advisory services.


**Knowledge And Skills Requirements**
* Technology expertise, in Microsoft solutions focused on D365 and power platforms, 20 years across roles spanning client delivery, innovation, solution architecting, people, and program management. At least last 10\+ years in technical leadership roles
* Demonstrates Dynamics and Power Platform technical expertise including associated Microsoft stack implementation technologies such as Azure, SharePoint, and Exchange/Outlook, with a proven ability to sell and execute large scale consulting engagements with a distributed delivery mindset
* Strong reputation in the talent market and the ability to build a strong \& continuous talent pipeline, based on one’s reputation and prior successes.
* Competitive intelligence about Big4 and Microsoft skills landscape
* Specialized industry\-sector experience in at least one or two sectors relevant to EY like Consumer products \& Retail, Technology, Media \& Entertainment, Telecom, Advanced Manufacturing \& Mobility, Oil and Gas, Government and infrastructure


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
